asya mīmāṃsākoṣasya praṇetāro gurucaraṇāḥ kevalānandasvāmino mudraṇaṃ prakāśanaṃ cāpari- samāpyaiva imamaśāśvataṃ lokaṃ vihāya brahmabhāvaṃ gatāḥ |
parantu kośaracanā ca svahastenaiva taiḥ parisamāptiṃ nītā karuṇāparavaśaiḥ |
mudraṇaṃ prakāśanaṃ ca nirvartanīyamasmistadanugṛhītaireva taiḥ |
caturtho'yaṃ bhāgasteṣāṃ samakṣameva prārabdhamudraṇasteṣāṃ prathamavārṣikyāṃ puṇyatithāvadya prakāśyate |
ye ke cāviśiṣṭā bhāgāḥ santi tān prativarṣaṃ krameṇa mudrayitvā prakāśayitumicchāmaḥ |
eteṣāṃ saṃpādanaṃ mudraṇaṃ prakāśanaṃ ca prādeśikarājyānāṃ bhāratīyasaṃgharājyasya ca tathā janānāṃ ca dravya- sāhāyyenaiva saṃpannaṃ bhavet, nānyathā |
gurucaraṇāstu antimocchvāsaparyantaṃ janakāruṇyavaśādidaṃ kāryaṃ svataḥ prabhāveṇa saṃpāditamasti |
tadetanmasyartherpakartavyaṃ bhavati vidyāvṛddhikāmaiḥ |
prādeśikarājyāni bhāratīyasaṃgharājyaṃ ca vidyāpraṇayino janāśca ṛṇusyāpākaraṇe dravyādi- sāhāyyaṃ kariṣyantītyāśāsmahe |
asmatsaṃpādanakāryadhurīṇaiḥ śrīraṅganāthaśāstribhirgurucaraṇaparicaryāparairetatsaṃpādanaṃ nirvartitamiti sapramodamanrdiśāmaḥ |

jyotiṣṭome tṛtīyasavane eva ājyena vyāghāraṇam |
‘viṣṇūn vyāghārayati’ iti vidhāya ‘tṛtīya ājyena’ iti vidhinopasaṃhārāt tṛtīyasavane eva vyāghāraṇaṃ vihitam |
tatra tātīyameva ‘tṛtīyye’ ityanūdya ājyalakṣaṇaguṇamātravidhiḥ |
kāladvayobhayaniyame vākyabhedāpatteḥ |
saṃkarṣa. 3|2|17.
jyotiṣṭome tṛtīyasavane eva ṣoḍaśino grahaṇam |
antarāgarmiṇī |
tṛtīyasavane vacanāt syāt |
bhāṣyam— athedānīmetat cintyate |
asti jyotiṣṭomaḥ |
tatra śrūyate ‘yaḥ ṣoḍaśī gṛhyate, indriyameva vīryamātman dhatte’ iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ savane-savane grahītavyaḥ, uta tṛtīyasavane iti |
kiṃ prāptam ? savanesavane iti |
kutaḥ ? pratisavanaṃ hi śrūyate gṛhṇāti ṣoḍaśinamiti |
śabdalakṣaṇe ca karmaṇi śabdo naḥ pramāṇam |
tasmān savanesavane ṣoḍaśī gṛhyate iti |
evaṃ prāpte, brūmaḥ |
tṛtīyasavane syādasya grahaṇamiti |
kutaḥ ? vacanāt |
bhavati hi vacanam |
‘tṛtīyasavane āgrayaṇād gṛhṇāti ṣoḍaśinam’ iti |
vacanaṃ naḥ pramāṇam |
tasmāttṛtīyasavane grahītavyaḥ iti |
atha yaduktam, pratisavanaṃ ṣoḍaśīgrahaṇamiti |
tṛtīyasavanagrahaṇa-stulyai tat |
katham ? ‘prātaḥsavane grāhyaḥ |
tejo vai prātaḥsavanam |
tejasa eva vajraṃ nirmitamīte |
mādhyaṃdine savane grāhyaḥ |
ojo vai mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanam |
ojasa eva vajraṃ nirmitamīte |
tṛtīyasavane grāhyaḥ |
paśavo vai tṛtīyasavanam |
paśūbhya eva vajraṃ nirmitamīte |
yat prātaḥ-
savane gṛhṇīyādvajra uttare savane vyatiricyeta |
yanmādhyaṃdine, madhyato vajraṃ nihanyāt |
tṛtīyasavane grāhyaḥ |
tat sarveṣu savaneṣu gṛhṇāti, na pūrve savane āti nītaḥ’ iti |
śā— kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇam antarācintāyāḥ ? (prābhākaroktaṃ kāraṇamāśaṅkya nirasyati-) mūlādhikaraṇa-siddhānte kālopalakṣaṇatvam ukthyasya svāsyati, sthite ca tasmin pūrvayoḥ savanayoḥ grahaṇamāśaṅkitumaśakyam, tayorukthyābhāvāt |
tasmāt madhye cintitam iti cet |
tadyuktam |
evamapi pūrvapakṣaṃ samāpya kartavyaṃ cintā syāt, na madhye |
kiñca ‘prātaḥsavane grahītavyaḥ’ ityādi vacanāt asya savanatraye grahaṇamāśaṅkyate |
na ca vacanasya paripanthī saṃbhavati |
tasmāt yadyapi pūrvayoḥ savanayoḥ ukthyābhāvāt taduttarakālata na saṃbhavati, tathāpi vacanabalāt grahītavyaḥ |
kālavacanaṃ tu tātīya-savanagrahaṇābhiprāyaṃ bhaviṣyati |
(parābhimānaṃ khaṇḍayati-) vindyate ca pūrvayorapi savanayoḥ ukthyam (pūrvaropi savanayoḥ kravyokthyasya sadbhāvaḥ |
svamatena antarā-cintāpayojakamāha-) tasmāt vicitrāgatiḥ sūtrakāraḥ |
cintāntaramadhye'pi pramaṅgāt cintā'ntaraṃ kṛtavān ityeva vaktavyam |
vi— ‘savaneṣu tṛtīye vā sa, trayoktyā bhavet triṣu |
dve ninditā tṛtīyasya vidhestatraiva gṛhyatām ||
bhāṭṭa— idamadhikaraṇaṃ sūtrakāreṇa pūrvādhikaraṇapūrvapakṣamadhye kutamapi vyāghrāsaukaryārtha pṛthak nirūpyate |
ṣoḍaśiyābhāsaḥ kiṃ niyamena savanatraye syāt, uta pakṣe tṛtīyasavane eveti cintāyām, ‘savanesavane gṛhṇāti’ iti śālā'ntaravacanena ananyaśeṣabhūtena savana-traye'pi tāvat grāhyaḥ |
ityavivādameva |
ataśca tadeka-vākyatayā ‘prātaḥsavane grāhyaḥ tejo vai prātaḥsavanaṃ tejasa

eva vajraṃ nirmitīte, mādhyaṃdine savane grāhyaḥ tejo vai mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ tejasa eva vajraṃ nirmitīte, tṛtīya- savane grāhyaḥ paśavo vai tṛtīyasavanaṃ paśavya eva vajraṃ nirmitīte|
yat prātaḥsavane gṛhṇīyāt uttare savane vyati- ricyeta, yanmādhyaṃdine tanmadhyato vajraṃ nihanyāt, tṛtīyasavane grāhyaḥ |
tatassarveṣu savaneṣu saṃgrahaṇāti, na pūrve savane ārtaṃ nītaḥ' iti śālā'ntaravacane'pi savana- traye eva vidhīyate |
grāhyaḥ iti kṛtyapratyayasya sarvatra śravaṇe 'sāmnā stuvīta' itivat nāyamikanyāyā- bhāvāt, tryambakavākye iva mīmāṃsāpadāśravaṇe tasyārtha- vādatvakalpanā'''nupapatteśca |
jātilakṣaṇanyāyena eka- vākyatālābhārthe pūrvasya vidheryathāvādaṃ prakalpya tārtīya- savanikasyaiva vidhivikalpanā tu śālā'- ntaraikavākyatālābhasya aviśiṣṭatvāt kalpāpādakatvācca na śaṅkayā |
iti prāpte, pūrvasavananindāpūrvakatṛtīyasavanasyaiva tanmātravidhiparatvāvasāyāt, pūrvavidhivyavasthāpi jatila- yavāgūnyāyena padaikavākyatālābhāthai taccheṣatvasyaiva kalpa- nāt, śālā'ntaraikavākyatābhāve'pi kṣatiravihāt, vikalpasya phalamutpattena adoṣatvāt |
asyāṃ śākhāyāṃ tārtīyasavanikaḥ eva vidhiḥ, savanatrayagrahaṇācca phalā- dhikyam |

ke. tadarthaśāstrāt |
ayedānīṃ kiṃ vivakṣitavacanā mantrā:, uta aviva- kṣitavacanā iti kimarthaprakāśane yāge upakurvanti, uta uccāraṇamātreṇeti |
atra prabhākareṇa saṃgatilobhāt itthamupavarṇitamadhikaraṇam- 'uru prathā uru prathasveti puroḍāśaṃ prathayati' ityatra 'uru prathā uru prathasva' iti mantrasya yadi artho vivakṣita:, tadā tasyārthā- deva liṅgāt puroḍāśaprathane tasya viniyogasiddhe: 'puro- ḍāśaṃ prathayati' iti tadarthaśāstramavivakṣitārthe syāt |
atha tadarthaśāstraṃ vivakṣitārtham, tadā mantrasya aviva- kṣitārthatā, iti parasparavyāghātāt aprāmāṇyaṃ codanāyā: |
iti pūrva: pakṣa: |
siddhāntastu, kiñcitkarasya kiñcitkāryaṃ kiñcit-kriyādvāreṇa viniyogo bhavati |
yathā ava- ghātasya kiñcitkarasya kiñcitkāryaṃ vrīhau dvitīyā'bhidheya- phalabhāgitārūpakriyādvāreṇa |
tena yatra etat tritayaṃ śrutito'vagamyate, tatra śrutita eva viniyogāvagamo bhavati |
iha puna: 'iti puroḍāśaṃ prathayati' iti śruti itkaraṇena kiñcitkaro mantra: pratīyate |
puroḍāśaṃ prathayate iti puroḍāśaprathanaṃ kiñcitkāryaṃ prakāśanaṃ ca kiñcit-kriyāviśeṣa: śrute: |
pratīyate tu mantrasya abhidhānasāmarthyarūpān liṅgāt abhidhāyakasya mantrasya kiñcitkaratā |
abhidheyasya kiñcitkāryatayā, abhidhānasya ca prakāśanarūpasya kiñcitkriyātvamiti |
tena mantraliṅgādeva tritayopasthite: mantraliṅgeva puro- ḍāśaprathane mantraviniyogakrama: |
tathā ca sati 'puro- ḍāśaṃ prathayati' iti śruti: anuvādidaiva |
yatra tu śrutyaiva tritayopasthiti: yathā 'aindryā gārhapatyamupa- tiṣṭhate' iti aindrīmantrasya kiñcitkāryatayā, upapadyetya tiṣṭhate: prakāśanārthatvāt prakāśanasya kiñcitkriyātva- miti, tatra śrutireva viniyojikā |
na ca iha mantra- liṅgasya viniyojakatvāt śrutervaiyarthyam, anvitakārya- pratipādanenaiva prayojanavattvāt |
nahi sarvameva anvita- kāryapratipādanāt anyat prayojanamasti |
anuvāde'pi tat anyāhatameva iti na parasparavyāghātāt aprāmāṇyaṃ codanāyā iti |

tadevaṃ pratyakṣaśrutitvāt mantrasya avivakṣitārthatvameva |
pūrvapakṣokta: parasparavyāghātāstu kuta: ? na ca vācyam 'yadyapi adhyāpanavidhiprayukkamadhyayanam, tathāpi nānta- rīyakatayā gamyamānasyārthasyāpi antaraṅgatayā adhyeya- dhikāraparyavasānāttamapekṣisata adhyayanavidhinā vivakṣi- tatvāt kṛtsnasyaiva mantrasya vivakṣitārthatvena bhavati' vyāghātā: ' iti, nirvāpamantre 'devasya tvā savitu: prasave' ityādināmavivakṣitārthanāmapi darśanāt |
na ca tepāmarthavādatvam, vidhyekavākyatāyā abhāvāt |
yathā ca tepāmuccāraṇaṃ humādipadānāṃ coccāraṇaṃ prayogasamavetārthā-
bhāvena arhārtham, tathā tadarthaśāstreṇa tādrūpyapari- cchedāt atrāpi arhārthameva mantroccāraṇamiti yuktam |
bhavatu vā mantrasya vivakṣitārthatve tatkārita eva mantra- viniyoga:, tathāpi tadarthaśāstrasya na avivakṣitārthatvam |
yata: arthavādādhikaraṇe eva etannirūpitaṃ yat 'vidhi- prāptaprāptasyānuvādakasyāpi arthavādasya adhyayanavidhi- vaśāt anuvādakatvenaiva vivakṣitārthatvam' (iti) |
ata: tulyanyāyatayā tenaiva gatatvāt tulyārthayo: mantratadartha- śāstrayo: anyatarasya anuvādakatvena vivakṣitārthatve sati yadetat vyāghātābhidhānam, tat pūrvaparāvahitasyaiva iti yatkiñcit etat |
iti yathāvārtikameva idamadhi- karaṇaṃ varṇanīyam |
arthavādānāṃ vidheyastyupayogadvāreṇa prāmāṇye nirū- pite sati idānīṃ mantrāṇāṃ vihitārthaprakāśanopayogadvāreṇa prāmāṇye pratipādayitavye kiṃ vivakṣitārthā mantrā:, uta avivakṣitārthā iti nirūpyate |

na tāvat vihitārthaprakāśane mantrāṇāṃ ṛtū- payoga: saṃbhavati, dhyānādibhirapi tadupapatte: mantrasyai- vyarthāt, viparītatvācca |

yadi hi 'uru prathā uru prathasva' iti mantro vivakṣitārtha: syāt, tadā tamidhānasāmarthyādeva puroḍāśaprathane vina- yogasiddhe: 'anena mantreṇa puroḍāśaṃ prathayati' iti viniyogaśruti: anarthikā bhavet |
tena etadavagamyate 'naiva mantrā vivakṣitārthā:' iti |

tadapi mantrasya vivakṣitārthatve na ghaṭeta |
evaṃ nirvāpamantre 'devasya tvā savitu: prasave' ityādināmaprayoga- samavetārthānāṃ avayavamavivakṣitārthatvaṃ vaktavyam |

ata: prakaraṇapaṭhitānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ ca mantrāṇāṃ yathāsaṃbhavaṃ śrutivākyaprakaraṇādibhivini- yuktānāṃ pradhānavidhinā svarūpameva aṅgīkṛtam |

tena ṛtaprayogajñāpanārthameva tat iti niśvī- yate |
ṛtaprayogaśca teṣāṃ prayājādivākyavat nārthamarpa- ṇena, nivṛttanyāyāṇāṃ tadarthasya vidhivyākhyādevāgate |
ataḥ svarūpeṇa teṣāṃ ṛtaprayogo vaktavyaḥ |
tacca svarūpaṃ svayamakriyātvāt yadyapi netikartavyatārūpeṇa prakaraṇena gṛhyate, tathāpi kārakatvena rūpeṇa grahītuṃ śakyate eva |
kiṃ karthatasya kārakatvamityapekṣāyām, 'yat śaknuyāt' iti dṛṣṭakalpanānusaṃdhāne vākyārthapratītiḥ |
tatkārya- mupalakṣyate |
anuṣṭheyavihitapadārthasattvaṃ ca prayogavidhi- rapekṣate |
mantravākyārthaśca pratītaḥ san ekadeśadhāreṇāpi śaknoti tat smārayitum, iti vihitapadārthasaraṇaphala- vākyārthajñānameva kurvatāṃ bhavati prakaraṇena kārakatvā grahaṇam |
tena uccāraṇameva eṣāṃ svarūpāmicchatye prayoga- kāle avaśyakaraṇīyam, na tu prayājādivākyānāmapi prakaraṇagrahaṇam, teṣāṃ svarūpasyānahāditi viśeṣaḥ |
yadi tu smṛtiphalamapekṣyeta dṛṣṭamarthajñānaṃ nopalabhyeta, tadā kevalādṛṣṭoccāraṇakriyayaiva asya kārakatvaṃ bhavedapi, sati tu paraṃparayā'pi dṛṣṭalame nādṛṣṭakalpanā upapatti- matī iti vivakṣitārthā eva mantrā iti |
na ca dhyānādibhirapi smaraṇopapattau mantravaiyarthyam, niyamā- dṛṣṭenaiva arthavattvāt |
yathā hi prakārāntareṇāpi vaituṣya- siddhau niyamārthaḥ avaghātādividhiḥ arthavān bhavati, tathā ayamapi iti nānupapannam |
ataḥ vivakṣitārthe- tvāmantrāṇāṃ na svādhyāyāvināśāya mantrādhyayanam |
nāpi mukhyārthānupapattyā lakṣaṇayā svarūpalatvam |
kiṃ tarhi ? mantrārthayatnaṃ apekṣitavākyārthāvabodhārthameva |
nanu kathaṃ tarhi siddhānte'pi aśābdasya mantrasya ṛtu- bhāvanā samanvayaḥ ? tatra kecit śābdatvasiddhayarthaṃ siddhānte'pi lakṣaṇyā svarūparatvaṃ vadanti, tadayuktam |
mukhyārthaparityāgena tatsaṃbaddhopapādakāntarakalpanā hi lakṣaṇā iti lakṣaṇātattvam |
na cātra pūrvapakṣavādimate iva siddhānte'pi mukhyārthaparityāgo'sti, vivakṣitārthatvā- mantrāṇām |
kintu prayogabhāvanā anuṣṭheyasmṛtimatareṇa anupapadyamānā prakaraṇamātmanārthavattvāya smṛtisamarthe mantrameva smṛtihetutayā aṅgīkurute |
tacca mantrasya aśābdatve na saṃbhavati iti tadarthe śrutārthapatyā tatpara- śabdakalpanāmeva ucitam |
viśvajitdādau iva upapādakatvena tarkiṃtasya svārthasya tatparaśabdakalpane, iti nānupapannam |
na ca tadarthaśāstrādibhiḥ avivakṣitārthatvam, tadarthaśāstrā- ścaiva abhāvāt; tatra 'barhirdevasadanaṃ dāmi' ityādī tāvat tatsaṃbhāvanaiva na samasti |
yatrāpi tatsaṃbhāvanā samasti abhyādānādamantreṣu, tatrāpi na śrutermantravini- yojakatvam |
kiṃ tarhi ? sāmarthyato mantrāḥ tadādāne prāptāḥ 'tāṃ caturbhirmādatte' iti śrutyā catuḥsaṃkhyā'pi ādāne vihitā |
tathokta ekādaśinyā'nye sati arthaika- hāyanīnyāyena parasparaniyame sati 'samuccitaireva caturbhi- mantraiḥ ādāne kartavyam' iti vākyārthaḥ saṃpadyate |
tena catuḥsaṃkhyāśravaṇaṃ tatra guṇārthameva |
taduktaṃ sūtra- kāreṇa 'guṇārthena punaḥśrutiḥ' iti |
evam 'imā- magman raśanāmṛtyetyasyābhimānādatte' ityādī ca mantrasya sāmarthyataḥ gardabharaśanāyāmapi prāptirbhavet |
tathāpi liṅgaviniyogasya śrutyanumāne viprakṛṣṭatvāt 'ityasyābhimānādatte' iti pratyakṣaśrutiśādeva mantrasya aśaraśanāyāṃ viniyogāt mantraprakaraṇinoḥ nairākāṅkṣye sati na liṅgadvāreṇa sāmānyaśrutikalpanam |
ataḥ pratyakṣaśrutireva mantraviniyojiketi |
kintu vinā- 'pi vidhinā prāpyataḥ kiṃ vidhinā iti prayojanagave- ṣaṇāyaṃ liṅgasya raśanāmātrāviṣayatvāt gardabharaśanāyāmapi mantrasaptau tannimittaiva prayojanam |
taduktaṃ grahādhikaraṇe 'rūpakaraṇadvārā śrutivat prakalpyate (yāvattu kalpyate iti mūle) |
tāvat pratyakṣyā śrutyā vidhiḥ śīghraṃ samāpyate |
aprāptavidhivayāmatau mantrasya niścitaḥ |
parisaṃkhyā phalenoktā na viśeṣapunaḥ- śrute |
prayojanaṃ vidheḥ kiṃ syādityati tu nirū- paṇe |
na gardabhābhidhānītaḥḥ phalamanyānnirvartanāt |
' iti (vā. 3|1|14 pṛ. 711) |
taduktaṃ sūtra- kṛtā 'parisaṃkhyā' (iti) |
'uda prathā ura prathasvati puroḍāśaṃ prathayati, yakṣyata iti prajā paśubhiḥ
tadvyaśāstrāt |
tadvyaśāstrāt
prathayati' ityatra tu puroḍāśaprathanameva aprāptaṃ vidhīyate |
na ca puroḍāśānyathā'nupapattyā prāptatvat prathanami- theyam, aprathitenāpi tvarāviśeṣavaśāt piṣṭakaniṣpatti- darśanāt |
prathanavidhau tu tasya avadyakartavyatvāt mantrasyāpi liṅgataḥ tanmayākathaṃ bhavati |
udāharaṇa- ntarāṇi bhāṣyāvārtikayoreva sugamānīti neha pradarśayante |
yatra punaḥ śrautaviniyogavaśādeva mantrasya tanmayākathana- sāmarthye dhurayantareṇāpi kalpanīyam, tatraiva śrute- rviniyojakatvam |
yathā 'ainyā gārhapatyamupatiṣṭhate' iti, 'dhānyamasi dhinuhi devān iti dadhadi tadupalā- nāvapati' ityādī |
nirvāpamantrādau tu devasyātvādidānāṃ asamavetārthatve'pi ekavākyabhāvabalena evaṃbhūtārtha- prakāśanainaiva smāritānāṃ vidheyārthānāmanuṣṭhānamṛdayāya iti niyāmakameva atrāpi dṛṣṭānurodhāt kalpanīyam |
yathā prokṣitābhyāmeva ulūkhalamusalābhyāmeva tadaiva vitubairhibhiḥ niṣpāditaḥ puroḍāśaḥ apūrvasādhanaṃ iti prokṣaṇamapi niyāmakaṃadhapatitam, tathaivāpi |
tena humā- dīnāmeva paraṃ arthabhāvena avivakṣitārthatvāt adṛṣṭārthameva viniyogaḥ : svādhyāyakaraṇārthe cādhyayanavidhinā pāṭhaḥ na tu anyatrāpīti |
nanu bhavatu vivakṣitārthatvam, prāmāṇyaṃ tu katham, vidhuddeśāvagatāthānuvādena anadhigatārthagatṛtvātvāt |
maivam |
nahi prativedavākyaṃ anadhigatārthagatṛlakṣaṇaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ vyutpādanīyam |
'ya evaṃ vidvān paurṇamāsīṃ yajate' 'ya evaṃ vidvān amāvāsyāṃ yajate' ityādī anuvādarūpatvena tadbhāvāt |
kiṃ tarhi ? dharmapramityupa- yogitvam (vyutpādanīyam) |
tacca paraṃparayā viddha- dākyasyaiva mantrasyāsti iti kimanupapannam |
prayojanam - yadi avivakṣitārthā mantrāḥ, tadā dhyānādibhiraiva saṃsmṛtānāmanānuṣṭhānam |
atha vivakṣitārthāḥ, tadā mantrasāritānāmeveti |
sūtraṃ tu - nahi laukika- vākyānāṃ mantravākyānāṃ ca kaścit viśeṣo'sti, yena pratīyamāno'pyartho na vivakṣyate iti |
'yo nāma kaści- diha saṃkalitaṃ prameya granthāntare likhati vā vadati svayaṃ vā |
markṛtetāmanugṛhītya, sa kīrtilopāt niḥsaṃtati- rjāgati janmaśatāni bhūyāt |
' iti bālavalmī- bhujaṅgāparanāmno bhavadevasya kṛtau tautātimata- tilake prathamasyādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ |

mantrādeva prāpte kiṃ punarvidhāne ? |

tadidaṃ mantrāṇāṃ vivakṣitārthatve liṅgadeva viniyogasiddheḥ anarthakam |
tasmāt avivakṣitārthā mantrā iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |

grāvāṇo'cetanāḥ kathaṃ śṛṇuyuḥ |

mantraliṅgenaiva raśanā''dāne prāptasya mantrasya vidhānaṃ gardabharaśanātaḥ |

'uru pratha uru prathasveti puroḍāśaṃ prathayati' iti mantravidhivākye pūrvapakṣiṇā punaruktā doṣo dattaḥ |
tannirāsārthaṃ siddhāntasūtramidam |

vāśabdaḥ śaṅkānirāsakaḥ |
tathā ca na tadarthaśāstravaiyarthyam |
aviruddhaṃ param |
mantrāṇāṃ niyatākṣarapadakramavattvena anarthakatvaṃ iti pūrvapakṣiṇā uktam, tannirasanārthe sūtram |
paraṃ dvitīya-sūtroktaṃ mantreṣu kramaviśiṣṭākṣarapadyamānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ sārthaka-mapi niyamādṛṣṭakalpanāyā pūrvapakṣiṇā'pi svīkāryatathā aviruddhaṃ na viruddham |
tasmāt nānarthakā mantrāḥ |
saṃpreṣe karmārthā'nupālambhaḥ saṃskāratvāt |

saraṇasaṃskārārthatvāt" (vā.) |

garhā nindā abhihitā anu-pālambhaḥ adopaḥ |
saṃskārārthatvāt adṛṣṭārthatvāt iti yāvat |
abhidhāne'rthavādaḥ |

abhidhāne'bhidhīyate anena ityabhidhānam 'catvāri śṛṅgā' iti mantraḥ |

yajñasādhanastutiḥ |
'oṣadhe trāyasvainam' iti, prātaranuvākastutyartham 'śṛṇota grāvāṇaḥ' iti |
guṇādavipratiṣedhaḥ syāt |

yaśayogo'bhāvāt |

durgrahatvāt akṣarābhyāsaḥ |
tasmānna doṣaḥ |

athāpi vaktā vivekī san itarasvanāthe prayukte, (atra ānandāśramīye caukhambīye ca 'itaravacanārthe' ityeva pāṭhaḥ, tathāpi sudhāyāṃ 'śrotupratāraṇāya' iti 'śrotujanārthenaiva' iti ca spaṣṭatvāt 'itaravaśva- nāthe' ityeva pāṭho niścīyate) śrotā ca na vividhakte (vicir pṛthagbhāve rucādiḥ) tadā'pi ekasya vivekena adhyāropābhāvāt, itarasya bhrāntyā adhya- sānāt (atra ānandāśramīye 'itarasyānyādhya- sānāt' iti, caukhambīye ca 'itarasya anyādhya- sānāt' iti saṃdhamakṛtvā mudritam |
tathāpi sudhāyāṃ 'nanu dvayoḥ śrotuśca vā bhrānto āropabhāve'pi bhrāntyā pratāraṇārthena vā paraśabdasya paratra prayogopapatteḥ' ityu- ttarāvaraṇalekhanāt 'itarasya bhrāntyā adhyavasānāt' ityeva vārtikapāṭhe niścīyate) naikampi gauṇalo- papattiḥ |
yadā tu dvāvapi bhrāntau, tadā ubhayoḥ sāha- śyādi nimittāntartivalatārthavyavasānāt āropābhāvaḥ |
(sāhaśyaṃ ādipadopātto vā sāhaśyahetuḥ guṇayogaḥ nimittaṃ yasya yatyarthasya [ vatipratyayārthasya ] tasya paratra paraśabdapravṛttau nimittatvena adhyavasānāt nāropakalpanā yuktā ityarthaḥ |

( bhāṣyakāreṇa sautraṃ vicāramupamṛnya coditaṃ nanu naivātra svargaḥ phalaṃ śrūyate iti, tasyārthamāha-) 'yajeta' ityanena ākṣitaḥ kartā, sa viśeṣyate svargakāmaśabdena ( puruṣavacanena ), yathā 'rājā rājasūyena yajeta' iti ( rājā iti viśeṣa- ṇam ) |
viśeṣaṇaṃ ca ( kāma : rājatvavat ) karmāṅgaṃ bhavati iti |
( uttarabhāṣyasyārthamāha-) evaṃ evaṃ ca ( kartṛ- viśeṣaṇatve abhyupagamyamāne ) yadi svarga ( eva kaścit ) nityaṃ kāmyate, nānyāni brahmavarcasādīni, tathā sati asādhāraṇatvāt viśeṣaṇamavakalpate ( svargameva yaḥ kāma- yate iti ) |
na ca īdṛśaḥ kaścidasti |
yadi vā ( kaścit ) svargaṃ na kadācit kāmyate, tathāpi taṃ ( asargakāmaṃ ) apekṣya viśeṣaṇaṃ ghaṭate svargakāma eva yaḥ iti |
kiṃtu īdṛśo'pi nāsti, yo na kadācit svargaṃ kāmayate |
atocyate, ( sa eva ) yasyāṃ velāyāṃ svargakāmaḥ : ( svargameva kāmayate ) tasyāṃ velāyāṃ darśapūrṇa- māsādīni kariṣyati ( tena kāladvāreṇa viśeṣaṇatvaṃ yujyate ) |
etadapi na ghaṭate |
yāvat ( puruṣaḥ ) śāstraṃ pradhānaṃ nirvartayati, tāvat aneka kāmā utpadyante ( dīrghakāle ) |
yadi ca śuddhameva svargaṃ kāmayeta, tatha ( sati bhavante ) yathāśruto darśapūrṇamāsau kṛtau syātām netarathā |
na ca īdṛśaḥ kaścit vidyate ( yo yāvajjīvaṃ svargameva kāmayate ) |
tasmāt kāladvāreṇa viśeṣaṇaṃ : ghaṭate |
( bhāṣyakāreṇa 'phalakāmo nimittaṃ bhavatu ityāhaṅka- nityānityasaṃyogavirodhatvāt parihāro'mihitaḥ, tamādhi pati-) yo'yaṃ nityānityavirodhaḥ : uktaḥ, na nopapadyate |

na ca īdṛśaṃ nityānityavirodho bhavati |
( katham ? ) āgneyāda- utyāhaḥ, teṣāmupattivacane na nityatvamavagamyate, : kāmyatvam |
te tu ( svarūpamātreṇa ) viparītamānā ekena vākyena yāvajjīvaṃ prati vidhīyante, apareṇa svarga- na ca yāvajjīva-svargakāmacodanayoḥ parasparasāpekṣā vidyate yena ye eva yāvajjīvike ( prayoge ) kartavyaḥ : te eva kāmye'pi kartavyaḥ iti ( avagamāt virodhaḥ syāt ) tasmāt kāmyanityābhyām ( anyonyamapekṣāmāṇābhyām ) utpattiḥ apekṣitānyā ( ityavirodhaḥ ) |
tasmāt ayuk midaṃ naimittikavanirākaraṇam ) |
tena tarhi anyatha ( naimittikatvanirākaraṇaṃ ) varṇyate |
svargakāmaśabdena nimittaṃ nāmidhīyate |
tasasyantena nimittamucyate yathā 'minne juhoti' iti, yadyuttena vā 'yajñobhayam' iti |
na cāyaṃ tasasyantaḥ, na ca yadyuttena yuktaḥ |
tasmāt ( nimittanāmiyāt ) anena svargaṃ kāmaya mānaḥ puruṣaḥ abhidhīyate |
( tatrāpi pūrvoktena nyāyena puruṣaparatvānupapatteḥ : viśeṣaṇaparatvameva ) |
sa ca puruṣa kiṃ sādhyatvena svargaṃ kāmayate, uta sādhanatvena iti dviprakārā'pi kāmanā asti |
yadi ayaṃ sādhanatvena svargamicchati, tathā sati ( pūrvoktena nyāyena viśeṣaṇa paratave sthite svargakāmādhikārapuruṣapakṣanyāyāt ) prīti viśiṣṭena yāgaḥ sādhanīyaḥ : ( bhavati ) tadā ca
tantranyāya:
na kaścit śabdo'sti, yena phalamabhiprīyeta|
yo hi ayaṃ svargakāmaśabdaḥ, sa sādhanavacanaḥ|
(na phalavacanaḥ iti-) anenāpi prakāreṇa anārabdhamadhyadhikaraṇam (phalābhāvena tantrāvāpacintā'nupapatteḥ)|
idaṃ tu ṣaṣṭhe nirākṛtam|
svargasya sādhanatvena na kāmanā|
kiṃ kāraṇam? sarve hyevaṃ kāmayante, svargo me syāditi! sādhye ca mukhyā kāmanā, sādhane tu nāntarīyakī, sādhanena vinā sādhyāsaṃbhavāt|
tasmāt sādhane yā kāmanā, sā gauṇī|
athavā ‘yajeta’ iti bhāvanā-vacanaḥ bhuktvā puruṣārthamākṣipati|
sa cākṣitaḥ kimarthaṃ prathamaṃ pūrayati? yadi ca kiṃmayo yāgena pūryeta, tadā coditamapi yāgaṃ na kaścit kuryāt|
tatra vidhiryā-hanyeta|
tasmāt svarge sādhanatvaṃ kāmyate, tena lakṣaṇa-yopāyaḥ ākṣitaḥ|
tatropāyatvena yāgo vidhīyate|

tena sāmarthyāmkena liṅgena pūrvapakṣā- vāntaraprakaraṇaṃ bādhitvā mahāprakaraṇādayaṃ gavāmayanahaṃ saṃpadyate |

darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ ārpayeya- tvasaṃpādanasamarthasyādhikāraḥ |
ārpayeyasya hānaṃ syāt |
bhāṣyam- darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ śrūyate 'ārpayeyaṃ vṛṇīte, ekaṃ vṛṇīte, dvau vṛṇīte, trīn vṛṇīte, na caturo vṛṇīte, na pañcātivṛṇīte' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ : kiṃ ārpayeyasya adhikāraḥ, uta neti |
kiṃ prāptam ? ārpayeyo''pi adhikriyate iti |
kutaḥ ? 'ārpayeyaṃ vṛṇīte' iti sāmānya- vacanam |
tasmāt ekaṃ varayati dvau vā |
tacca darśayati 'ekaṃ vṛṇīte, dvau vṛṇīte' iti |
tathā pratiṣedhati 'na caturo vṛṇīte, na pañcātivṛṇīte' iti |
na hi aprāptasya pratiṣedho'vakalpate |
tasmāt ārpayeyo''pi adhikriyate iti |
evaṃ prāpte, brūmaḥ |
yo na ārpayeyaḥ sa nādhikriyate |
kutaḥ ? 'trīn vṛṇīte' iti viśeṣavacanāt |
vidhiśca aprāptatvāt |
nanu ekaṃ vṛṇīte iti viśeṣavacanamasti |
neṣyate, vidhāyikā vibhakterabhāvāt |
nanu stutyā vidhāyaste, yayā trīn vṛṇīte iti |
ucyate |

ekatvādayaḥ (tu) avayavānuvādaḥ |
itarathā (yadi ekatvā''dyapi vidhīyeta, tataḥ :) vākyabhedaḥ aṣṭakalpanā aśruta- (vidhi-) kalpanā ca (prasajyeta) |

pālītvate tu pūrvatvāvacchedaḥ |
bhāṣyam-- tvāṣṭra pālītvataṃ vidhāya idamyucyate ' yatparyabhikṛtaṃ pālītvamatutsṛjanti' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ ki tvāṣṭrasya paryabhikṛtasya utsargo vidhīyate, uta tasmāt yāgāntaramiti |

atha pālītvataśabdaḥ utsṛjatātena saṃbadhyate, tato yāgāntaram |
kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? yāgāntaramiti |
kutaḥ ? pūrvasatvātḥ pālītvataḥ |
ubhayaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaḥ kathaṃ pālītvata- śabdena anūyeta |
api ca tvāṣṭra utsargaṃ vidhīyamāne paryabhikṛtamiti viśeṣaṇaṃ nāvakalpeta |
ato brūmaḥ paryabhi- kṛtasya pālītvatā vidhīyate, sa eva yāga iti |
evaṃ prāpte, brūmaḥ |
na karmāntaram, pūrvasyaiva utsṛjatātena avacchedya vidhīyate |
kimiva bhaviṣyati ? yajjimattā tāvat kalpayitavyā na bhaviṣyati |
utsṛjatiśabdaśca śrutyā utsarge vidadhat vākyena na bādhito bhaviṣyati |
karmā- ntarapakṣe vākyena pālītvatāt vidhīyamānāyā arthāt prāpta utsargo dhātunā anūyeta |
api ca paryabhikṛta pālītvatā pūrvasya viditaiva, sā vidhātuṃ na śakyate |
tasmāt pūrvasya karmaṇaḥ avacchedaḥ |
yattuktaṃ tvāṣṭra utsarge vidhīyamāne paryabhikṛtamiti viśeṣaṇaṃ tāvat nāva- kalpeteti |
naiṣa doṣaḥ |
atantrameva atra pālītvatacchaḥ; nāśau viśeṣyate |
ata eva tvāṣṭraḥ pālītvata ubhaya- viśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaḥ kevalena pālītvataśabdena lakṣaṇayā anūyeta iti na doṣaḥ |

caturthī saṃpradānasyārthaikaiva|
ata eva dīkṣitadaṇḍasya dānamātreṇa pratipattisiddhernārthavat sa eva daṇḍo 'daṇḍī preṣānanvāha' ityanena preṣānuvacane viniyujyate|
tena na preṣānuvacanaṃ daṇḍasya prayojakamiti niruddhapakṣādavāpi na tadanuṣṭheyam|
iti prāpte, 'karmaṇā yamabhipreti sa saṃpradānam' iti smṛtyā kriyāṃ prati vyāpyamānaṃ karmakārakaṃ pratyapi saṃpradānasya vyādhyamānatvāttvervinicchalena kasya- cidvyāpyamānasya īpsitatve kalpamāne 'vyāpyavyāpyasya sutarāṃ vyāpyatvam' iti nyāyena maitrāvaruṇasya eva upayogāddeśyatvam|
vedavidyādau tu bādhāt svargādereva uddeśyatā|
yadyevaṃ cālambhanaṃ daṇḍasya prayojanamiti nādṛṣṭārtha- tvamapi|
na caivaṃ 'daṇḍa' iti dvitīyā'nupapattiḥ; saktuvat karaṇatvalakṣaṇārthatvāt|

sakṛdapi tadāpatteḥ anīpsitakarmatve'pi ca uddeśyatvekamanimitta- avāt vā daṇḍasya anīpsitakarmatvenaiva anvayaḥ|
saṃpra- dānasya tu satyapi prādhānye saṃpradānatvenaiva anvayācca dvikarmakatvātpattirapi bodhyam|
ataśca daṇḍaviśiṣṭa- dānasya upayogāpekṣāyāṃ 'daṇḍī preṣānanvāha' ityādinā preṣānuvacanethatvena viniyujyate|

atra brūmaḥ|
śrautavidhairyatkarmatve'pi asaṅka- prayājaśeṣābhidhāraṇanyāyena ārthikadānapratipattidhanvantara- kalpatayā prakṛte'pi kāryasaṃkocopapattiḥ|
na cātra madhye pratipatyapekṣā'bhāvena kalpakābhāvāttanyāyavilakṣaṇam, dānavidherdaṇḍāntaraprayojakatvaśaktikalpanābhiyā kārya- saṃkocamaṅgīkṛtyā madhye tadapekṣopapatteḥ|
dṛṣṭa loke anyānurodhenāpi avaśyapekṣitaviṣaye svakāryasaṃkocena akāle eva tadapakarṣaḥ|
śakyate cātra svavākyātgāsya maitrāvaruṇopakārakatvābhāvāt tadaṃśe daṇḍapratiparthyatvaṃ vaktum|
svasvatvātyāge'pi samarpaṇamātreṇāpi preṣānuvacano- papatteḥ|
ataśca pratipatyavarodhena dīkṣitadaṇḍasya tadvi- bhayatvasiddhiḥ|
atra eva sarve sarveṣāṃ daṇḍānāṃ dānam, evaṃ ca paramayukttadaṇḍajīvivāca śrautadānavidheḥ preṣānuvacanā- devaṃ dīkṣādaṇḍasyeṣṭe daṇḍāntarānākṣepakatvam, tantrāśādau tu daṇḍāntarākṣepakatvaṃ akṣāmyañjananyāyena (4|1|10) iṣṭameva|
śrautadānavidhau ekākṣaśravaṇādekadaṇḍadānameva maitrāvaruṇopakārakatvamiti sarve preṣānuvacane eka daṇḍa ityapi bodhyam|
idaṃ ca dīkṣitadaṇḍaprāpakavacanasya pārtha- sārathyadīmīmāṃsaikairilikhitatvāt tadabhāvamabhipretyo- ktam|
vastutastu taittirīyaśākhāyām 'yadīkṣitadaṇḍaṃ prayacchati' iti sārthavādavākyatvāntaraśravaṇāt 'krīte' iti dīkṣitadaṇḍarahitavākye pratipattivvinyatatvakalpane'pi na kṣatiḥ; taittirīyavākyenaiva maitrāvaruṇapadāśravaṇena dānasya pratipattisiddheḥ|
krītavākye tu maitrāvaruṇapada- śravaṇena tadvādhāttvānyāyeḥ tadupakārārthatvameva|
ataśca taittirīyavākye yacchateḥ saṃpradānāpekṣāyāṃ krītavākye satvatantradaṇḍasyekṣatvakalpanāgauravaparihārāt paraspara- pekṣatayā dīkṣitadaṇḍasyaiva maitrāvaruṇopakārārthatvasiddhiḥ|
na ca taittirīyavākye krītavākyavihitadaṇḍe eva dīkṣāsaṃbandha- vidhānopapatteḥ na pratipattivākyamiti vācyam|

bhāṣyam-- evaṃ cet paśyasi 'nāriṣṭhahomeṣu pārṣaṇa- homyośca svāhākārasya niveśa:' iti, prakṛtāvāpi nāriṣṭhahomādau nāsya niveśo ghaṭate |
tatrāpi vaṣaṭkāra eva prāpnoti |
sa hi aśiveṣeṇa darśapūrṇamāsayorvihitaḥ 'dvayakṣarau vaṣaṭkāraḥ' |
eva vai prāpnapati |
saśabdo yace- 'nyāyattaḥ' iti |
nanu svāhākāro'pi pratyakṣaṃ paṭhitaḥ |
satyaṃ paṭhitaḥ, vaṣaṭkārastu vihitaḥ |
ataścaitane |
'nāsya yajño vyadhate, prajāpatau pratiṣṭhita' iti svāhākāra pāṭhene prāptaṃ bādhyate, pāṭhe hi ānumāniko vidhiḥ pratyakṣena vidhinā bādhyate |
na cet tatrāpi niveśaḥ, uttarārtha eva svāhākāro bhavati vikṛtyarthaḥ ||
uktaṃ samavāye pāradaurbalyam |
bhāṣyam-- atrāha naitadyuktaṃ 'vaṣaṭkāreṇa svāhākāro bādhyate' iti |
kutaḥ ? yataḥ ṛkte śrutyādīnāṃ samavāye parasya daurbalyam |
iha ca vākyaprakaraṇayoḥ saṃnipātaḥ |
prakaraṇena vaṣaṭkāraḥ prāpnoti nāriṣṭhahomeṣu, tanmantrapadeḥ ekavākyatvāt svāhākāraḥ |
vākyaṃ ca prakaraṇāt balīyaḥ |
nanu svāhākārasya upariṣṭāt pradānārthau vaṣaṭkāraḥ prayojyate (svāhākāro'ṣṭa iti) |
na khalu svāhākāreṇaiva pradānaṃ nirvartitam, kathamavihitaḥ pradānārthe svāhākāraḥ pradānārthe nirvartayiṣyati |

darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ āhāyeṃ 2036 darśapūrṇamāsayorijyāḥ
māsayoḥ 'āhāryapurīṣāṃ paśukāmasya vediṃ kuryāt' iti puruṣārtham, na kratvartham |
bhā. 4|1|22|2 varṇakaṃ 2. oṃ darśapūrṇamāsayorijyāḥ iti nyāyaḥ |
caturdhopāyanyāyena darśapūrṇamāsālyānā- meva yāgānāṃ prādhānyāt netareṣāmaṅgatvāt samaprādhānya- siddhiḥ |
su. pṛ. 923. oṃ darśapūrṇamāsayorijyāḥ pradhānānyaviśeṣatvāt |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ āgneyaḥ puroḍāśaḥ, agnīṣomīyaḥ puroḍāśaḥ, ājyenopāṃśuyājaḥ, aindrāgnaḥ puroḍāśaḥ, dadhipayo rūpaṃ sāṃnāyyam, āghārī ājyabhāgau prayājāḥ anuyājāḥ patnīsaṃyājāḥ samiṣṭayajuḥ sviṣṭakṛt, iti yāgāḥ śrutāḥ |
te kiṃ sarve eva pradhānabhūtāḥ, uta tatra kecit guṇabhūtāḥ iti vicāre pūrvapakṣayati |
darśapūrṇa- māsayoḥ yāgayoḥ yāvataḥ ijyāḥ tāni sarvāṇyeva pradhānani syuḥ |
aviśeṣāt sarveṣāṃ svargaphalakatvasya yāga- tvasya ca samānatvāt |
adhiyā'ṅgāni kānicid, yeṣvaṅgatvena saṃstutiḥ, sāmānyato hyamisaṃstavaḥ |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ āghārājyāgmaprayājādayo yāgāḥ āgneyādivat pradhānameva syāt rājasūyavat iti pūrvapakṣe sati siddhāntasūtramidam |
na sarveṣvaiva rājasūyādikkatu vartamānaḥ sarve yāgāḥ pradhānam, kintu kānicit āghārādigāyāḥ aṅgāni syuḥ, na pradhānam |
apivā- śabdena pūrvapakṣavyāvṛttiḥ |
yeṣu yāgeṣvaṅgatvena saṃstuti- rbhavet |
'amīṣū yā etasya yajñasya, yadāpārī' 'caturbhī vā etau yajñasya, yadāyabhāgā' ityādiḥ saṃstutiḥ |
hi yasmāt amisaṃstavaḥ aṅgānāṃ sāmānyaḥ, sāmānyadharmaḥ, aṅgānāṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇe amisaṃstṛtatvaṃ ityarthaḥ |
abhi- saṃstavena lakṣyate idamaṅgamiti |
tasmāt āghārājyābhāgā- dayaḥ yāgā api aṅgemeva, na pradhānam |
tathā cānyārthadarśanam |
siddhānte hetvantaramāha |
'prayājeprayāje kṛṣmalaṃ juhoti' iti sauryayāge kṛṣṇalavidhānāya prayājānuvādasya anyārthasya kṛṣṇalavidhānārthasya darśanaṃ bhavati |
na ca pradhānasyānuvādo bhavati |
tasmāt kānicidaṅgāni, na sarve yāgāḥ pradhānāni |
aviśiṣṭaṃ tu kāraṇam, pradhāneṣu guṇasya vidyamānatvāt |
pūrvapakṣī āha |
tu-śabdena siddhāntapakṣavyāvṛttiḥ |
prayājādīni nāhmāni kintu pradhānānveva |
teṣāmaṅgatva- siddhaye saṃstavarūpaṃ uktaṃ kāraṇaṃ tu pradhānaṣvapi āgneyā- diṣu aviśiṣṭaṃ samānameva 'śiro vā etadyajñasya yadāgneyaḥ' ityādiśruteḥ |
saṃstavāṅgatvarūpasya guṇasya pradhānaṣvapi vidyamānatvāt |
tasmāt prayājādyo'pi pradhānameva |
nānukte'nyārthadarśanaṃ parārthatvāt |
siddhānte 'tathā cānyārthadarśanaṃ' iti yaduktam, tatra pūrvapakṣī brūte |
prayājādīnāṃ aṅgatvavacane nyāye vā anukte sati anyārthadarśanaṃ na aṅgatvasya sādhakam |
yattu darśitam 'prayājeprayāje kṛṣṇalaṃ juhoti' iti, tat parārtham |
prākṛtāt prayājāt anyasyaiva prayājasya aprākṛtasya vidhānārtha tat |
tasmāt sarvāṇi pradhānāni iti punaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ |
pṛthaktve tvabhidhānaniniveśaḥ śrutito vyapa- deśācca, tatpunarmulyalakṣaṇaṃ yatphalavattvam, tatsaṃ- nidhānasaṃyuk tadaṅgaṃ syād, bhāgitvāt kāraṇa- syāśrutānvayasambandhaḥ |
punaḥ prāptaṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ tuśabdo vyāvartayati |
na sarve yāgāḥ samapradhānāni |
tatra phalavanti pradhānāni, itarāṇi tu aṅgāni |
tatra trikadvayaṃ phalavat āgneyopāṃśuyājā- bhīmīyānāmekaṃ trikaṃ paurṇamāsīsaṃjñakam |
aindrāgnādhipayo- rūpaṃ dvitīyaṃ trikaṃ amāvāsyāsaṃjñakam |
darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ iti dvivacanena trikadvayena uktakrameṇa uktayordvayornirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ |
svargakāma iti padena ca phalavattvamuktam |
tadetadāha, 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta' iti śrutitaḥ śravaṇāt, darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ iti dvivacanena vyapadeśācca abhidhānayoḥ |
darśa iti pūrṇamāsa iti nāmadheyayoḥ pṛthaktve minne trikadvaye niveśaḥ prayogaḥ |
yat phalavattvam, tat punaḥ mukhyalakṣaṇaṃ mukhyasya pradhānasya lakṣaṇam |
tat punaḥ, tat ityarthaḥ |
anena phalavattvaṃ pradhānalakṣaṇa-

muktam |

tasmāttadeva pradhānam |
atha aṅgalakṣaṇamāha, tatsaṃnidhau phalavatsaṃnidhau yat phalena asaṃyukttam, tat aṅgaṃ syāt |
phalavatsaṃnidhāvaphalaṃ tadaṅgaṃ ityarthaḥ |
tādṛśaṃ ca āghārājyabhāgādikam |

kāraṇasya aṅgatvakāraṇasya bhāgitvāt |
bhāgo bhajanaṃ vacanam |
uktatvāt asaṃyuktam 'prakaraṇādikṛtyarthāvirbhāvāt' (3|1|4|11) ityatra ityarthaḥ |
aśrutasya anyasaṃbandhaḥ prayājādīnāṃ pradhāna- phalādyanvena kenacit phalena saha saṃbandhaḥ na śrutaḥ |
evaṃ 'phalavatsaṃnidhau aphalaṃ tadaṅgam' iti aṅgalakṣaṇasya uktatvāt prayājādīnāṃ aphalatvāt aṅgatvameva teṣāṃ svīkāryam, na pradhānatvam |
guṇāśca nāmasaṃyuktā vidhīyante, nāṅgeṣūpa- padyante |
siddhānte hetvantaraṃ sūtram |
cakāraḥ samuccaye |
'caturhotrā paurṇamāsībhimiśret, pañcahotrā'māvāsyām' iti abhimarśanādayo guṇāḥ nāmasaṃyuktāḥ |
paurṇamāsī amāvāsyā iti nāmabhyāṃ saṃyuktā vidhīyante |
te ca vibhayaḥ pradhānaṣvevopapadyante nāṅgeṣu upapadyante |
tasmā- dāghārādayaḥ aṅgemeva, na pradhānam |
tulyā ca kāraṇaśrutirnyaiāṅgāmisaṃvandhaḥ |
pūrvapakṣiṇā yaduktam 'aviśiṣṭaṃ tu kāraṇam' iti tat pariharati |
anyaiḥ puruṣārthayaiḥ pūrṇamāsasya aṅgānāṃ āgneyādīnāmavayavānāṃ abhimarśaḥ evaṃpūpā kāraṇaśrutiḥ, sā āgneyādīnāṃ pradhānatve'pi tulyā |
yāgāvayavānāṃ puruṣāvayavatveḥ stutiḥḥ āgneyādīnāṃ pradhānatve'pi yujyate iti bhāvaḥ |
sā ca stutiḥ 'śiro vā etad yajñasya yadāgneyaḥ, hṛdayamapāṃśuyājaḥ, pādāvagnīṣomīyaḥ' iti |
utpattāvabhisaṃbandhastasmādaṅgopadeśaḥ syāt |
'aviśiṣṭaṃ tu kāraṇaṃ0' iti sūtroktasya samādhānaṃ 'tulyā ca kāraṇaśrutiḥ0' iti anvayahitapūrvasūtreṇa yaduktam, tatraiva viśeṣapratipādanāya prakṛtaṃ sūtram |
yo'yaṃ paurṇamāsyaṅgānāmisaṃbandhaḥ puruṣāṅgaiḥ saha uktaḥ, saḥ abhisaṃbandhaḥ upapattavyaḥ |
yathā jāyamānasya puruṣasya agre śiro jāyate, madhye madhyama, paścāt pādau, evaṃ āgneyāḥ agrataḥ, upāṃśuyājo madhye, agnī- ṣomīyaḥ paścāditi |
tassāmānyādeṣā stutiḥ |
tasmāt aṅgopadeśo'yaṃ stutyarthaḥ syāt |
na tena āgneyādīna pradhānatvahānirbhavati |
tathā cānyārthadarśanam |
siddhānte hetvantaraparaṃ antimaṃ sūtram |
tathāya āgne- yādiprādhānye āghārādīnāṃ cāṅgatve anyārthadarśanamapi bhavati 'caturdaśa paurṇamāsyāmāhuto hūyante, trayodaśāmā vāsyāyām' iti |
pañca prayājāḥ, dvāvājyabhāgau, āgneyo pāṃśuyājāgnīṣomīyādayaḥ, trayo'nuyājāḥ |
sviṣṭakṛcceti caturdaśa paurṇamāsyām |
pañca prayājāḥ, dvāvājyabhāgau āgneyaḥ, sāṃnāyyam, sviṣṭakṛt iti trīṇi, trayo'nuyājā iti trayodaśa āhutayaḥ amāvāsyāyām |

bhāṣyam- naitadasti agnīdhaḥ preṣaḥ; adhvaryoḥ praipārtha iti |
kiṃ khalu ? adhvaryureva abhīdhaṃ preṣyat |
evamadhvaryuṇā preṣaḥ praipārthaśca ubhayapi kṛto bhaviṣyataḥ |
tatra ādhvaryavamiti samākhyā anugṛhyate |
tasmāt adhvaryureva mukhyaḥ syāt |
kimasya mukhyatvam ? yadanena sarve kartavyaṃ samākhyānāt iti |
atha yaduktaṃ 'adhvaryuḥ pracaritā dṛśyate' iti, taducyate |
satyaṃ dṛśyate, na tu asya praipārthakaraṇe pramāṇamasti cintyamānam |
tasmāde- tat mithyā darśanam |
yasya hi darśanasya pramāṇaṃ nāsti, bhyāmohaḥ saḥ |
yathā śuktikāyāṃ rajatavijñānam |
asti tu abhīdhaḥ praipārthakaraṇe pramāṇam |
tasmāt āmīdhraḥ pracaritā |
pracaritāraṃ ca adhvaryuśabdo dṛśyate |
tasmāt gauṇaḥ |
ādhvaryave vede samāmnātān padārthān karoti iti kṛtvā adhvaryuiratyucyate āmīdhra iti |
tasmāt ādhvaryavaḥ preṣaḥ, āmīdhraḥ praipārtha iti |
vā-'mukhyaṃ vā pūrvacodanāt' iti prāthamyāt preṣe samākhyātaḥ kartā yuktaḥ |
nahi tadānīṃ virodhaḥ kaścidasti |
tasmistu prayukte virodhāt praipārthe anyo bhavati |

bhāṭṭa- tatrāpi bahuṣu pradhānabhūteṣu praipārtheṣu samākhyā- bādhe pramāṇābhāvādekasmin 'prokṣaṇīrādāya' ityādi- prepa eva adhvaryudhāvena anyakartavyam |
ata eva 'tiryyaṃ spayaṃ dhārayitvā saṃpreṣamāha yadanyaṃ dhārayet, spayo vajreṇādhvaryuḥ kṣiṇvīta' iti dhārayitṛbhirmamadhe darśayati |
iti prāpte, praipārtheṣu anyakartṛtve'pi prayo- jakāvenāpi adhvaryoḥ kartṛtvopapatteḥ samākhyāyāḥ |
kutrāpi aghādhāt praipārthān anya eva kuryāt, praipadhāraṇaṃ tu adhvaryuḥ |

tathā pratiṣedhe sāmānyarūpasya codakasya viṣayaviśeṣāt ukālanaṃ ' nāpyaṃ vṛṇīte' iti |

satyapi ca prayojane prayojakā- bhāvāt puroḍāśapālādeḥ cavādiṣu bādha iti|

yagaṃ prati 'vrīhibhiryajeta' iti vrīhīṇāṃ karaṇatvaṃ śrūyate|
kartṛvyāpāragocaraśca karaṇaṃ bhavati|
yathā (bhāvanāvibeke ) tena vrīhīmupādāya tairhavyamiti|
karaṇatvaṃ ca teṣāṃ utpattiviśiṣṭapuroḍāśavade yāge tatprakṛtitvena saṃbhavati, iti eṣa śāstrārthaḥ: 'vrīhīmupādāya tairhaviḥ saṃpādya yajeta' iti|
atra ca 'haviḥ saṃpādya yajeta' ityanūya 'vrīhibhiḥ' ityetāvanmātraṃ vidhīyate|
evaṃ ca sati ārthikaṃ havissaṃmatyanvayam, na śrautam|
na caivaṃ taṇḍuleṣu saṃbhavati|
nahi tat prakṛtyupādānena haviḥ saṃpādanīyaṃ (haviḥ saṃpādanaṃ) prāptam, yat 'vrīhibhiḥ' iti niyamyate, lokasiddhānaiva taṇḍulamupādāya yartu śakyatvāt|
nanu prakṛtāvapi laukikameva puroḍāśamādāya yāgasya kartuṃ śakyatvāt kathaṃ prakṛtyupādānena haviḥ-

iti cet, taducyate 'haviḥśrapaṇa- sādhyaṃ hi puroḍāśatvamiṣyate|
svayaṃ kartṛkatā tasya śrapaṇasya vidhīyate |
puroḍāśarūpaṃ hi haviḥ nāntareṇa śrapaṇaṃ sidhyati|
tat hi laukikameva upādeyaṃ svameva vā prakṛtyupādānena saṃpādayitavyamiti, yadyapi utpattivākyāt aniyamaḥ prāptaḥ 'aṣṭakapālina yajeta' ityasya ubhayathā'pi upapatteḥ, tathāpi 'kapāleṣu śrapayati' iti vacanāt nānyena arpitaṃ gṛhṇāti iti svayaṃ kartṛkatvameva tu asya vidheyam, sarvamevat utpatti- vākyasāmarthyasiddham|
kapālāni utpattivākyasiddhāni, śrapaṇamapi sāmarthyāt nāśrapitasya puroḍāśatvamasti iti śrapitadravyaviśeṣavacanatvāt puroḍāśatvādiśabdānām|
tataḥ svayaṃkartṛkatvāttatra vidheyā|
yathā āha bhagavān bhāṣyakāraḥ: 'kapāleṣu śrapayati iti vacanāt nānyena śrapitaṃ gṛhṇāti' (1|4|6|9 pṛ. 341) iti taddhalena prakṛtyupādānaṃ prāpnoti iti|
nahi anyathā svayaṃ śrapayituṃ śakyate|
evaṃ prakṛtadravyopādāne prāpte kimavasthaṃ kiṃ rūpaṃ ca dravyamupādeyaṃ ityākāṅkṣāyām, vrīhiśabdena satuṣajāti- viśeṣavācinā tanniyamāt piṣṭataṇḍulāvasthayoḥ nīvārādīnāṃ ca vyāvṛttiḥ|
yadi tu anenaiva śāstreṇa 'prakṛtyupādāya haviḥ saṃpādyeta, bañca vrīhibhiḥ' iti vidhīyate, tato gauravam|
'kapāleṣu śrapayati' iti ca vidheḥ ānarthakyaṃ satyāṃ gatau syāt, tacca anyāyyam|

pūrvapakṣe 'vaidhātavyā dīkṣaṇīyā bhavati' iti āgnā- vaiṣṇavakāryāpatyā (vaidhātavyā) taddharmairyujyate yathā nīvārāḥ prokṣaṇena (yujyante) |
siddhānte tu āgnāvaiṣṇavāpūrvaprayuktā dharmāḥ vaidhātavyāyāṃ ca apūrvāntaram |
na cāpūrvāntaraṃ apūrvāntaradharmāt gṛhṇāti |
(mādhyante prayojanamākṣipati-) anupapannamidaṃ prayojanam |
(katham ?) 'vaidhātavyā dīkṣaṇīyā bhavati' iti sāmānādhikaraṇyam (anayoḥ) |
tatra yadi mukhyatve'pi aṅgi pade gṛhyetāyāṃ (tataḥ) sāmānā- dhikaraṇyaṃ nopapadyate |
tasmāt ekamatra gauṇaṃ padam, anyat mukhyam |
tatra prāthamyāt avirodhācca vaidhātavyāpadaṃ mukhyam, dīkṣaṇīyāpadaṃ tu (jaghanyatvāt saṃjātavirodhaṃ ca) āgnīyaṃ ṛtūpakāraṃ lakṣayati |
tasmin lakṣite vaidhātavyā vidhīyate (vaidhātavyā dīkṣaṇīyākāryakāriṇī bhavatīti) |
sā (ca) vidhīyamānā tatkāryāpasatvāt taddharmān labhate |
siddhānte'pi yathā khalevālī yūpakārye vidhīyamānā taddharmāṃn (aṅganādīn) labhate |
tasmāt ubhayoḥ pakṣayoḥ tulyā dharmaprāptiriti |
athocyeta 'vaidhātavyā dīkṣaṇīyā bhavati' ityanena vaidhātavyāyāḥ yat kāryam, tat nivārya dīkṣaṇīyākārye (tasyāṃ) vidhīyate |
tacca (dīkṣaṇīyā- kāryam) ātmīyaireva (yathāsiddheḥ) dharmaiḥ ātmīyena cāpūrveṇa vaidhātavyā sādhyayiṣyati, na dīkṣaṇīyādharmān grahīṣyati siddhāntavādinaḥ |
(etat dūṣyati-) pūrva- pakṣe'pi yadi dīkṣaṇīyākāryaṃ (yathāsiddhe) vaidhātavyā vartata, tathā sati ātmīyaireva dharmaiḥ : tatkāryaṃ sādhyayiṣyati prasiddhadharmakatvāt |
aya na vartate (dīkṣaṇīyākāryaṃ vaidhātavyā, tadā) sutarāṃ ātmīyā eva dharmāstasyāḥ |
api ca paramāpūrvamuktayāmāpi vāṅniyamasya prakṛtau āgnāvaiṣṇavo viśiṣṭaṃ dvāramabhūta (āgnāvaiṣṇavāpūrva- mityarthaḥ :) |

soma-- prādhānye'pi prayojakatva na syāt iti pūrvakāpaparyaprayojakatvamākṣipya samarthayate iti saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu-- devataiva sarvān dharmān yojayet bhojanasya yāgasya idaṃ haviḥ devatā mokṣyate iti kriyamāṇatvāt yāgasya bhojanaśabdena nirdeśaḥ |
devatā'rthatvāt bhojanasya bhojanatve dṛṣṭāntaḥ atithiditi |
vi—'devaḥ prayojako'pūrve vā, sa'co'sya phala- dalataḥ |
na vidheye guṇo hyeṣo'pūrvasya phalitocitā |
' bhāṭṭa—evaṃ tāvadapūrvamaṅgīkṛtya devatāprāsādasya prayojakatvaṃ nirākṛtam |
iha tu tadanaṅgīkṛtya devatāprāsādaḥ eva prayojaka'stu ityāśaṅkā prasaṅgāccirākriyate |
tatra devatāyāḥ saṃpradānatvāt tasya ca karmakārakāpekṣayā'pi abhiprāyamāṇatvena prādhānyāt yāgasya pūjāpastaskāra- kātvāgateḥ, tasyāḥ śropayogāpekṣayā 'ma evainaṃ bhūti gamayati' 'tṛpta evainamindraḥ prajābhiḥ tarpayati' ityādyarthavādānusārāt pramnāyāḥ phaladāttve; yāga- syaiva phalajanakatve pramāṇābhāve apūrvasādhanatve sutarāṃ pramāṇabhāvaḥ |
astu vā devatāyā abhiprāyamāṇatvāpi tasya 'brāhmaṇāya gāṃ dadāti' ityādi brāhmaṇasya phala- dātṛtvā'saṃbhavena abhāvān prādhānyāsaṃbhavena prādhānya vyabhicāreṇa tatkalpanā''nupapatteḥ |
pratyuta bhāvārthādhikaraṇa- nyāyena yāgakaraṇikāyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ bhāvyāpekṣāyāṃ svargasyaiva tatvenānvayāt, devatāyā api saṃskāryatve uddeśyatvāna kathañcinmitatvātmedyapatteḥ |
devatāyā eva yāgākhyasya tathāpi yāgasya phalajanakatve vyāpārāpekṣāyāmabhāvātpūrva kalpanā'pekṣayā rātrisatravat ārthavādikadevatāprāsādasya dvāratvakalpanāt taprayuktatvasiddhiḥ |
prasādasya ca vigraha bhogādityetirekeṇa anupapatteḥ |
arthavādādyanusāreṇa vigraha bhogādikalpane'pi na doṣaḥ |
iti prāpte, prasādo hi yadi icchā rūpaḥ, tadā tasyecchātvena tatphale prati kāraṇatve atiprasaṅgapatteravarasya daśādikartṛtvāt phalatvaṃ ityeva- mākārakecchātvena tadvācyam, tathā ca kāraṇatā'vacchedake gauravam |
daśādijanyaphalabhogame jāte'pi tatkartṛtvānapāyāt anyakṛtadaśarpaṇātprasādasya anyasya phalapattiśca ataḥ phalavyakttitvāvacchinnaṃ prati tadvyaktiḥ |
sā phala vyaktirbhavatu ityevamākārakecchātvena kāraṇatvaṃ vācyam tathā cānekakāryakāraṇabhāvakalpane kāraṇatā'vacchedave gauravaṃ ca |
kiñca etādṛśaprasādo yadi brāhmaṇatarpaṇānte, tada yāgānāṃ nahatyādeva utpattyanāpattiḥ |
yadi tu tattayāgebhyo 'pi avāntaraprasādā āgneyayatkiñcittvadādijanyaṃ phalaṃ bhavatu ityākārikā iṣyante, tadā devatānāṃ amoghecchatvasya arthavādeṣu pratipādanāt daivādaprītīmīyākaraṇe'pi phalā- pattiḥ |
athaitadarthavādātmeva abhyupagamya tādṛśamahā prasādasya vijātīyacchatvenaiva apūrvavādena iva vijātīya- phalatvāvacchinnaṃ prati kāraṇatā, avāntaraprasādānāṃ ca vijātīyatacchidratvenaiva mahāprasādaṃ phalaṃ ca prati kāraṇatā, phāraṇatā'vacchedakasaṃścayaśca svajanakāyāgasyama- cāryatvam, kāryatā'vacchedakasaṃścayaśca phalaṃśe samavāyaḥ |
nātaḥ kartṛtve phalapattiḥ |
avāntaraprasāda mahāprasādayoḥ parasparaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāve pratyāsattiḥ ubhayatra svajanakāyāga samavāyitvameva |

nanve 'apitvā śabdapūrvatvād yajñakarma pradhānaṃ syād guṇatve devatāśrutiḥ' iti sūtre ( 9|1|9 ) bhūtabhavyasamuccāraṇanyāyena devatāyāḥ yāgaṃ prati guṇatve abhihite, 'nanu kameṇe'pi aiṣṭitāda- bhipretatvaṃ devatāyā gamyate' ityāśaṅkaya 'nāsyā abhi- pretatāmapahunumahe |
taddhitaśabdena caturthyā vā saṃyuktāsya devatātvasya vākyādabhipretatā gamyate' ( bhā. pṛ. 1652 ) iti bhāṣye anarthakavarṇasamūhasya prātipadikatvābhāve taddhitacaturthīyogayogyatāt tatsaṃyogābhidhānena arthagrahaṇe (ca) śabdamātrasya devatātvaṃ nirastam |
daśame ca 'vidhi- śabdasya mantratve bhāvaḥ syāt tena codanā' (10|4|123) ityatra 'āvāhanādau yenakenacit paryāyeṇa devatā'bhi- dhānasiddheḥ vidhigatyāgnyādidānenādaraḥ' iti pūrvapakṣa- vidhyā 'āgneyo'ṣṭākapālaḥ' itividhivigatana agnidābdena devatāyā haviḥsambandhavidhānāt mantrakāryaṃ devatoddeśe vidhi- gatasya śabdasyoccāraṇaṃ kāryam' iti siddhānte, 'kā punarayaṃ devatā nāma' iti pṛṣṭvā indrādīnāṃ yuktānāṃ vede yā yatra 'agnidevatā vāto devatā' ityādidevatā- śabdaḥ prayuktaḥ, sā devatā iti pramatadvayaṃ ahaḥśārdūlādīnāṃ anupasaṃgrahāt nirasya, svamatena 'sūkṣmabāhyo havi- rmāṃjya devatāḥ' ( bhā. pṛ. 1927 ) iti bhāṣye 'agnidevatyaṃ sūktam' 'agnidevatyaṃ haviḥ' ityādiprayogāt 'āhutibhājo vā anyā devatā anyāḥ stomabhāja- śchandobhāvāḥ' iti liṅgācca sūktastutyasya tyajyamāna- haviruddeśatvasya ca devatābhidhānādarthasya stutyatvo- ddeśyatvāvagateḥ 'mūrtānāmamūrtānāṃ cetanānāmacetanānāṃ ca śrutvā kaścidyadi prati tādarthyaṃ saṃkalpanīyānāṃ devatātvaṃ bhaviṣyati' ( bhā. pṛ. 1927 ) iti ca bhāṣye mūrtānāṃ cetanānāṃ devatātvābhidhānāt 'yasya vācakaṃ śabdamuddiśya smṛtvā vā havistyāgami iti saṃkalpaḥ kriyate sā (devatā) bhavati ( tatra )' ( bhā. pṛ. 1927 ) iti ca bhāṣye uccāraṇārthatvāt diśaḥ uccāryamāṇena śabdena 'prajāpati manasā yajeta' ityādivāci vā sarvamāne vācyasya devatātvābhidhānāt, 'nanu evaṃ sati sutarāṃ yenakenacit agneḥ śabdena nirdeśaḥ karaṇīyaḥ' iti cāśaṅkaya 'bhave- detadevaṃ yadi agniśśabdo'pyasyatyāgārthamapyanyat artho'pi haviḥsambandhārthe prayājyeta' ityupakramya ( bhā. pṛ. 1927 ) 'devatāyāśca yajñasādhanabhāvo na rūpeṇa bhavati |
kena tarhi ? saṃbandhanā śabdena' ityādinā bhāṣye ( bhā. pṛ. 1928 ) śabdasaṃbandhitvādvyatiriktikābhidhānāt śabdasya devatātvaṃ nirastaṃ bhavati |

jyotiṣṭome 'tvarā vā eṣā yajñasya tasmāt yatki- ñcit prācīnamīṣomīyāt tena upāṃśu caranti' iti śrūyate |

atha 'yatkiñcit prācīnamagnīṣomīyāt' iti śrutaṃ vākyame śrutiśabdena gṛhyate |

asādhakaṃ tu vādaryyāt |
... ‘svargakāmo yajeta’ ityuktam, tatra yāgaḥ pradhānaṃ svargo guṇaḥ |
svargaśabdaḥ sukhasādhanaparaḥ, dravyaṃ kriyāsādhanam, iti yāgaḥ sādhyaḥ, svargaḥ tatsādhanaṃ iti pūrvapakṣe siddhāntasūtram |
tādaryyāt yāgasya svargatvāt yāga eva svargasya sādhakaḥ |
tuśabdaḥ pūrvapakṣavyāvartakaḥ |
pratyarthaṃ cābhisaṃyogāt karmato hyabhisaṃbandha- stasmāt karmopadeśaḥ syāt |
yāgaḥ svargārthaḥ, na tu svargo yāgārthaḥ |
ataḥ svargaḥ pradhānaṃ karma guṇaḥ, iti siddhānte ‘yajeta ityekapadaśrutyā yāgasya bhāgyatvena svargakāmapadopāttasya na bhāgyatvam’ iti śaṅkā |
tannirāsārthaṃ sūtramidam |
prati arthe iti padabhedaḥ |
arthyate abhilaṣyate iti arthaḥ svargapadavādiḥ |
arthe prati svargādikaṃ prati vidheḥ abhisaṃyogāt anvayāt, karmataḥ hi karmaṇā eva sādhanatvena abhisaṃbandhaḥ anvayaḥ |
tasmāt hetoḥ : ‘yajeta svargakāmaḥ’ ityatra svargādisādhanatvena karmopadeśaḥ karma eva yāgādeḥ upa- deśaḥ syāt |
tathā ca prītirūpasya svargasya bhāgyatvam, yāgādeśca guṇatvaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
evaṃ ca phalabhoga- saṃbhavena karmakartuḥ adhikāro'sti iti adhikārādhyāya ārambhaḥ iti bhāvaḥ |

agnihotre ‘payo vrataṃ brāhmaṇasya, yavāgū rājanyasya, āmiṣā vaiśyasya’ iti śrutam |
idaṃ vrataṃ puruṣārthaṃ ṛtvarthaṃ veti saṃśaye vākyena viniyuktatvāt puruṣārthe iti utsṛṣṭaṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ tuśabdena nirasya siddhāntayati |

kriyārthānāṃ ṛtvarthānāṃ ṛtugatānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ brāhmaṇādirūpāṇāṃ idaṃ vrataṃ saṃskāraḥ syāt śarīradhāraṇārthaḥ balakaraṇārthaśca |

sa ca ṛtudharmaḥ na kevalapuruṣadharma iti siddhāntā ukte, tarhi puruṣasaṃyogaḥ ‘payo vrataṃ brāhmaṇasya’ ityādinā kimarthaṃ uktaḥ ? ityāśaṅkāyām uttaramāha |
brāhmaṇarājanyavaiśyakartṛkānāṃ prayogāṇāṃ pṛthakatvāt vrata- vyavasthātheṃ puruṣasaṃyoga uktaḥ |
brāhmaṇakartṛkasya abhihotrasya aṅgaṃ vrataṃ payaḥ, rājanyakartṛkasya yavāgūḥ, vaiśyakartṛkasya āmiṣā iti |
evaṃ prayogāṇāṃ pṛthakatvāt tatkartṛkatvaṃ agnihotre vrataṃ vyavasthitaṃ vyavasthitaṃ syāt iti puruṣa- saṃyoga uktaḥ |

iha yat kathambhāvākāṅkṣāyāṃ agnyādhānādi upanipatati, tadasya saṃbandhatve kāraṇam ( tat kathambhāvātmakaṃ prakaraṇaṃ agnyadhānādeḥ itthambhāvena saṃbandhatve kāraṇaṃ bhavati ) |
na cānyasya bhavitumarhati |
( na svarūpeṇa prakaraṇaṃ anyasya saṃbandhatve kāraṇaṃ bhavati ityarthaḥ |
ānandā- śramīye tu atra ' nānyasya bhavati, na cānyasya bhavati '

iti pāṭhaḥ |
vākyadvayamapi ca ṭippaṇyāṃ vyākhyātam |
paraṃtu tat asyadīye likhite tannarane vā nāsti ) |
adhikārāditi cet |
bhāṣyam- iti cetpadyasi, na prakaraṇaṃ viśeṣakaṃ vrīhīṇāmiti |

adhikārāt jñāsyatyadhvaryuḥ |
ime bhaktārthāḥ, ime kāryārthāḥ |
tatra kāryārthān prokṣatīti |
tulyepu nādhikāraḥ syādyoditaśca saṃbandhaḥ, pṛthak satāṃ yajñārthenābhisaṃbandhastasmādyaḥ prayo- janam |
bhāṣyam- tulyā ete vrīhayaḥ |
ya eva bhaktārthāsta eva karmārthāḥ, na pṛthak kecit karmārthā nāma |
nanu ye nirastāste karmārthāḥ |
sayaṃ bhavedetat |
prokṣaṇādiṣu doṣe na syāt |
nirvāpe tu doṣaḥ |
na tatra kecana prakṛtā vidyante |
pṛthaksatāṃ yajñārthena nirvāpaḥ śrūyate |
katham ? apareṇa gārhapatyaṃ prāgīśamano'vasthitaṃ bhavati |
tasya dakṣiṇa cakramākṛhya anaso'dhinirvapati iti |
tasmāddharmasya sarvaviṣayatvaṃ prāpnotyeva |
pūrveṇa hetunā'pūrvaprayuktaṃ prokṣaṇādīnāmiti |
śā- 'tatra śrutilīyatvād vrīhādidravya- śeṣatā |
prakriyā''gatā pūrvaśeṣatvasyāpyadhinī ||
vrīhādirūpaśeṣatve satyānarthakyamāpatet |
prokṣa- ṇasya, vinā'pyasmāt tatsvarūpasya siddhitaḥ ||
tasmāt sādhanarūpaṃ yad vrīhīṇāṃ śāstracoditam |
tena rūpeṇa saṃbandhaḥ prokṣaṇādervidhīyate ||
' tasmāt sarvaiṣābheva vrīhiṇāṃ viniyogānāṃ dravyādīnāṃ saṃskārāḥ apūrvabhāvāttvebhṛtāḥ |
tadvikṛtiṣu prākṛtārtheṣu dravyāntareṣu saṃskāreṣu uhitavyāḥ |
soma- sūtrārthastu- dravyādi prayojakaṃ dvitīyāśruteḥ dviśabdaśca saṃyogāt |
vāśabdaḥ vākyaliṅgasaṃyuktā- pekṣayā śruteḥ viśeṣadyotanārthaḥ |
vi- 'vrīhādyaiḥ prayoktāro'pūrve vā prokṣaṇādiṣu |
' vākyaśrutimānāt syāt, noditākāṅkṣayā'ntimaḥ ||
' bhāṭṭa- atra mūle dravyasaṃkhyāhetusamudāyānāṃ yatra śrutyā uddeśyatā, tatra vrīhādineva, na tu apūrvasādhana- tvena, prakaraṇena śrutiṃkocāyogāt ityādyuktya svarūpe
ānarthakyāpatteḥ apūrvasādhanatveneti siddhāntitam |
tatra 'vrīhīn prokṣati' iti dṛṣṭodāharaṇasya 'caturhotrā paurṇamāsīm' iti samudāyādāharaṇasya ca kathañcit saṃbhave'pi saṃkhodāharaṇasya 'trīn parīdhīn' iti mantrasya 'agniṃ suvaḥ' iti mantratad apūrvasādhanībhūtaparīdhī- yatprākāśātārthatvasya siddhatvāt anudāharaṇatvamiti vārtikakāraiṇavoktam, tathā hetudvāhe'ṇe'pi |
yat 'śūrpeṇa juhoti, tena hyannaṃ kriyate' ityatrakaraṇahetunā tasya vyāpyatvāvagamāt, nyāyasya ca sarvatra prādhānyadarśanāt annakaraṇoddeśena homaḥ saṃskārakatayā vidhīyate iyā śaṅkya tṛtīyā homaṃ prati śūrpasya karaṇatvāvagateḥ 'teḥ hyannaṃ kriyate' ityasya cārthavādatvāt, homoṭya ārādu pakārakaḥ : apūrvārtha iti vicāritam, tat vyāpyasyāpi juhādeḥ kratuṃ prati prādhānyadarśanāt arthavādatvasya ca hetvadhikaraṇe sthāpitatvāt tadvicārasya ca uhānupayogi tvāccopekṣitam |
kiñca sarvasyaivāsya vicārasya ādhikāriṇena gatārtha tetyanyathā varṇyate |
yadyapi yajñakarmeti sūtreṇa (9|1|1) saṃnipatyopakārakamātre apūrvasādhanatvalakṣaṇā siddhā saṃskāre ceti sūtreṇa (2) ca āntarālikānāṃ yāgatvā dikāraṇatā'
tāmyāmulakhalamusalābhyām' ityādi tatsamānajātīyavākyā- ntare vā, tatrāpi prokṣaṇaviśiṣṭasya vrīhiviśiṣṭasya ca vidheyakriyāviśeṣaṇatvena vidhau kṛte paścādaṇaikahāyanī- nyāyena parasparānavyāt prakṛtau tajjātīyasya prokṣaṇe'pi vikṛtau tajjātilope'pi tāsthānāpannadravyāntare eva prokṣaṇalābhāt sidhyati ūhaḥ |
prokṣaṇaṃ prati viśeṣaṇa- vidhivelāyāṃ apūrvasādhanatvasyaiva uddeśyatvā'vacchedakatvam, lakṣaṇā paraṃ (kevalam) na tatrāsti, vrīhipadena vrīhiva- syaiva abhidhānāt |
apūrvasādhanatvasya kalpitavidhāveva svapadenaivabhidhānāt |
evaṃ yatrāpi saṃskāravidhyuttaraṃ tacchabdena saṃskṛtasya viniyogaḥ yathā 'tate payasi' ityādi tatrāpi saṃskāra- vākye payastvasamānādhikaraṇadhamavicchinnoddeśyenaiva dadhā- nayanavidhiḥ, na tu payastvāvacchinnena ānarthakyāt |
sa ca dharmaḥ uttitvācca iṣṭasāmānyamiva sāmānyataḥ
hṛdayādisamudāyānuvādaḥ |
dravyadevatāsaṃbandhānimittena yajinā ālambhavākye hṛdayādisādhanakayāgānuvādaḥ |
tathā 'somena yajeta' ityatrāpi haviḥprakṛtisomalatāvidhānāya yajinā aindravāyavādivākyeṣu dravyadevatāsaṃbandhānumita- yāgamudāyānuvādaḥ iti |
atrāpi paurṇamāsīvat samu- dāyānuvādameva |
nanu 'hṛdayasyāgre'vadyati' ityādivākyeṣu na tāvad yajiḥ śrūyate |
nāpyanumīyate, dravyadevatāsaṃbandhānavagamāt |
hṛdayādisaṃbandhaścāvadānasya vatsālambhatvat yāga- mantareṇāpi saṃbhavācca yāgānumāpakatvam |
katham ? paśu- dravyāmīṣomadevatākayāgavidhānenaiva mukhyaguṇaśabdāpoṣatto dīkṣitavākye lakṣaṇayā paśusaṃbandhena hṛdayānuvādaḥ |
ata paśoḥ tāvat sarvathā pūrvapakṣo na saṃbhavati |
tathā 'somena yajeta' iti pratyakṣayāgavidhau sati kathaṃ aindravāyavādi- vākyeṣu dravyadevatāsaṃbandhānumitasya yāgasya vidhānam ? 'pratyakṣavidhisiddhatvāt labhyate lānumānikam' iti nyāya- virodhāt |
aindravāyavādivākyānāṃ candravāyadevatāśrauta- grahaṇavidhānenaiva upapannatayā nāśrutayāgavidhānākṣepa- padyate |
bhavatu vā dravyadevatāsaṃbandhena aindravāyavādipañca- yāgavidhānam, tathāpi 'somena yajeta' ityatra somadravya- yāgavidhānopapatteḥ kathaṃ yajetaḥ yacchandātparāgābhāve'pi yāgānuvādakatvaṃ saṃbhavati, ataḥ kathaṃ some'pi pūrvapakṣaḥ ? iti |
ucyate, paśo tāvat yadyapi hṛdayādisaṃbandhena avadānaṃ bhūyate, tathāpi 'sānnāyyaṃ vā tadābhyatvāt' (sū. 8|1|40) ityanenaiva nyāyena ayamavadyatiḥ sānnāyyavadyatiprakṛtiḥ |
sānnāyyavadyateśca yāgīya- dravyasaṃskārarūpatvāt etasyāpi yāgīdravyasaṃskārakatvam |
tacca tadeva saṃbhavati, yadi hṛdayādīni yāgasādhanāni bhavanti |
tena yathāyāgasādhanakārasaṃskārasaṃbandhena pūtī- kānāṃ yāgasādhanatvaṃ kalpyate, yathā vā lakṣaṇasaṃbandhena phala- camasasya abhyamāṇamapi yāgasādhanatvaṃ kalpyate, tathe- hāpīti paśuśabdena hṛdayādīni anuyante, yajinā ca tatsaṃbandhinā yāgānnuya amīṣomau devatātvena vidhīyate |
na ca paśuśabdasya hṛdayādyanuvādatve lakṣaṇaiva doṣaḥ, yato vidhau hi lakṣaṇā doṣamāvahati, nānuvāde |
athavā yodīkṣitavākye devatāvidhiśarnādeva hṛdayādivākyeṣu yāgānumānam |
nanu yodīkṣitavākye devatāviśiṣṭayāgavidhirvāstu kathaṃ devatāmātravidhānam ? maivam |
evaṃ hi manyate, avaśyaṃ siddhāntādinā'pi hṛdayāditāvadānasaṃskārasya- rthāt paśuśabdasya lakṣaṇayā hṛdayādiparatvaṃ vaktavyam |
tadyadi yodīkṣitavākye yāgotpattiḥ, tadā vidhau lakṣaṇā, sā cāyuktā 'na vidhau paraḥ śabdārthaḥ' iti nyāyāt |
avacativākyānāṃ tu yāgotpādakatve anuvāde lakṣaṇā, sā na doṣāya |
dṛṣṭā ca bhāvinīmapi apratimālocya utpattivyavasthā |
yathā saṃkhyā'dhikaraṇe bhāvinīmāti- deśikāvadānagaṇaprāptimālocya saptadaśayāgotpattiḥ |
tena paśuśabdena hṛdayādīni anuya yajinā tatsaṃbandhinā yāgānnuya amīṣomau devatātvena vidhīyate iti siddham |
tathā some'pi aindravāyavādivākyeṣu dravyadevatāsaṃbandhena tāvadavaśyaṃ yāgo'numātavyaḥ |
na hi dravyadevatāsaṃbandha- pratipādakasya yāgaṃ vinā svārthe paryavasānamasti |
taduktam- 'yathā''gneyādivākyānāṃ na prāgayāgānumānataḥ |
svārthaparyavasānaṃ tathā some'pi dṛśyatām ||
' iti |
(vā. pṛ. 510) |
nanu evaṃ śrutinimittadeyamevedaṃ vākyaṃ niṣpannam 'indra- vāyudevatyena yajeta' iti |
tathā sati somavākya- vihitayāgānuvādena amīṣomavākye iva hṛdayādyanuvādena devatāvidhānamevāstu, kimatra viśiṣṭavidhisvīkāreṇa ? maivam |
somavākyopapannayāgānuvādena aindravāyavākyai- devatāvidhau ekayāgasaṃbandhena tadiralakṣaṇāmiva ekasmin yāge vikalpaḥ syāt |
taduktam- 'tathaikavacanārthatvāt palāśaśabdādirāya |
tatsaṃbandhe vikalpyante yāge- 'smin devatāstathā ||
' iti |
(vā. pṛ. 512) |
tathā sati 'āśvino daśamo gṛhyate, tṛtīyo hūyate' iti kramadarśanam |
tathā 'daśaitānagṛhyate' prātaḥsavanaṃ gṛhṇāti' iti samuccadarśanaṃ ca nopapadyate |
aindravāyavādivākyānāṃ tu yāgotpādakatve bhinnayāgasaṃbandhitvāt devatānāṃ samuccaye sati kramasamuccayadarśanamupapadyate |
tathā sati rūpābhāvena yāgavidhānābhāvāt yacchandādyabhāve'pi aindravāyavādi-
vākyavihitayāgasamudāyānuvāda evāyaṃ 'somena yajeta' ityatra yajatiśabdaḥ |
somaśabdaḥ aindravāyavādivākyā- vagatasaptaprakṛtisomalatāvidhānārtha iti |
evaṃ prāpte, abhi- dhīyate |
bhavedayaṃca yatra paurṇamāsīvat vākyāntararopaja- yāgapratyabhijñānaṃ bhavet |
sarvatra khalu pratyabhijñānabalena anuvādo bhavati |
punaranuvādasiddhayarthaṃ pratyabhijñānaṃ kalpyate |
na ca avaghaṭitagṛhātivākyeṣu yāgaḥ śrūyate, yenātra pratyabhijñānam |
taduktam 'prakṛtapratyabhijñānaṃ vākye yatropalabhyate |
tatra syānuvādatvaṃ nacātraivaṃ pratīyate ||
' iti |
(vā. pṛ. 512) |
tena yodīkṣitavākye eva dravyadevatāsaṃbandhānumitasya yāgasya vidhānam |
somavākye tu pratyakṣasiddhameva dravyaviśiṣṭayāga- vidhānam |
na ca vācyam, paśudravyakasomadravyakayāgotpattau hṛdayādīnāṃ rahasya ca aviniyuktatvāt tatsaṃbandhinoḥ avadānagrahaṇapuraskārayorvidhānamanarthakameva syāditi |
na hi paśuhomamātrapratītiḥ, yataḥ avaghaṭitagṛhātivākya- darśanena tayoravikṛtayordevatoddeśena yāgavidhānāt |
kiṃ tarhi ? hṛdayādiparvanto rasaparyantaśca, tena somaviniyogena tadantargatapaśuhṛdayasomarasayorvināyuktatvāt viniyukta- gocarameva saṃskāravidhānam |
yathā vrīhiṇāstra taṇḍulā- diparyantatvāt 'taṇḍulān pinaṣṭi' ityādisaṃskāra- vidhānam |
na caivaṃ vidhau paśusomaśabdaḥ saṃskāra- jñāpanārthaḥ, taduktam 'dravyeṇāyantabhinnaṃ saha cintyaṃ balābalam |
hṛdayādisadāramaṅgatvaṃ paśusomayoḥ ||
' iti |
(vā. pṛ. 516) |
kiñca viśeṣataḥ paśudāharaṇe avaghaṭito yāgaḥ saṃbhavitumapi na śakyate |
yadapi hṛdayādyavadānasya sānnāyyāvadānaprakṛtitvena taddharmatvameva sati yāgīyadravyasaṃskāratvāt yāgānumānamityuktam, tadapi ayuktam |
sānnāyyavadyatereva prakṛtau aghoṭitatvena dharma- saṃbandhābhāvāt |
na ca 'dvirhavipo'vadyati' ityanena tāvadavadānaṃ vidhīyate |
kiṃ tarhi ? arthaprāptānuvādena dvitvamātram |
etat sarvapradānādhikaraṇe (2|4|18 bhā. 14|17) vistareṇa vakṣyāmaḥ |
bhavatu vā hṛdayādyava- dānasya tatprakṛtitvam, tathāpi na yāgasādhanasaṃskāratvaṃ tasya |
itikartavyatā cātidiśyate, na dharmamātram |
ato na tadaśenāpi yāgakalpanā |
pūtīkāmivaphalacamasa- bhakṣaṇayostu yāgasādhanadravyasaṃskārayoreva prakṛtauyava- prakaraṇāmyāṃ pūtīkaphalacamasasaṃbandhena upādānamiti vaiṣamyam |
yadapi yodīkṣitavākye paśuśabdasya lakṣaṇayā hṛdayādiparatvamāpādya vidhau lakṣaṇā'bhāvāt bhāvadevatā- saṃbandhanirośena avaghaṭitavākye eva yāgānumānamityu- ktam, tadapi yāgavidhau paśuśabdasya hṛdayādiparyantatvena mukhyayāgasya uktatvāccirastam |
paśudāharaṇaṃ tāvaccirapa- vādam |
evaṃ 'somena yajeta' iti pratyakṣe yajo aindravāyavā- divākyeṣu yāgaḥ saṃbhāvayitumeva na śakyate |
na ca āgneyādivākyānāmindravāyavādivākyeṣu na yāga- mantareṇa svārthaparyavasānamastīti vācyam |
yataḥ indravāyu- devatoddeśena dravyagrahaṇavidhānenaiva vākyaparyavasānāt |
āgne- yādivākyeṣu tu puṃnyāpārasya vidhiviṣayatvāt bhavyarthasya ca apuṃnyāpāratvāt avaśyaṃ kalpanīye puṃnyāpāre dravyadevatāsaṃbandhena yāgaḥ eva kalpyate ityuktam |
iha grahaṇarūpasya puṃnyāpārasya śrutatvātparyavasānaṃ vākyasyeti |
nanu tajyamānaṃ haviḥ prati uddeśyatvaṃ na kiñci- jātyā samasta |
ataḥ kathaṃ grahaṇe devatā'nvayaḥ ? iti |
ucyate, na hīdaṃ grahaṇamarthāntarabhūtam, kiṃ tarhi ? yāgāvayavabhūtamevaitat |
na hi devatoddeśena tyajyate |
na ca anyadeśena gṛhītasya anyoddeśena tyāge yāgaḥ saṃpadyate |
tena devatoddeśena gṛhītasyaiva haviṣastyāgo yāga iti na yāgāvayavabhūte agne devatoddeśo virudhyate iti |
evañca yāgāpekṣāyāṃ 'somena yajeta' ityayameva pratyakṣaśruto yāgo'stīti nātra yāgakalpanāprāptaḥ |
iti |
tathā ca sati imeva yāgadeśabhūtagrahaṇasaṃbandhinī devatā prakṛta- yāge devatāpekṣeṇa saṃbadhyate |
na ca evaṃ sati khādirapālāśadādināma ekabandhanārthatve devatānāmapi ekayāgārthatve vikalpaḥ syāt |
yato nātra khādirapālāśadādināma bandhane, devatānāṃ yāge vākyena vidhānam, yena vikalpaḥ āpadyeta |
kiṃ tarhi ? grahaṇamukhena devatānāṃ yāgānnvayaḥ |
grahaṇāni tāvat bhinnakāryāt yugapadeva prakaraṇinā gṛhītāni bhinnakāryāt samucceta-
dravyasaṃyogāccodanā

bhyāni |
tena grahaṇadvārā devatānāmapi samuccayaḥ yuktaḥ |
paramayaṃ viśeṣaḥ, grahaṇayāgayorekā devatā, yena yaduddeśena gṛhītaṃ taduddeśenaiva tyaktavyam |
tena pratigrahaṇaṃ somayāgasya abhyāsaḥ |
evaṃ ca sati trivaṇadaśagrahadaśacamasadānāṃ pratyabhyāsaṃ bhinno yāgaḥ |
'somena yajeta' ityanena śālena sakṛdutpādita iti mantavyam |
tathā sati 'āśvino daśamo gṛhyate, tṛtīyo hūyate' iti kramadarśanam, tathā 'daśaitānadhvaryuḥ prātaḥ savane grahaṇān gṛhṇāti' iti samuccaya- darśanamupapannaṃ bhavatīti somodāharaṇamapi anavadyam |
prayojanam--pūrvapakṣe hṛdayādīnāmaindrāyavādipāgānāṃ pṛthaktvāt svārthatvāt viśeṣacodanāliṅgāt tadarthātideśe sati na sakaladharmaprāptiḥ |
siddhānte tu paśyāgasya soma- yāgasya ekatvāt vikṛtau sakaladharmapiriti |
sūtraṃ tu--paśusomadravyasaṃyogāt paśuvākye somavākye ca yāgacodanā yāgavidhānam, yasmāt prakṛtayāgageṣu anarthako niṣprayojano dravyasaṃyogaḥ |
'nahi tasya guṇārthena' iti sunāyavayo bhāṣyākāreṇa somodāharaṇe somalatāyāḥ pradeyatvena guṇārthatvamāśaṅkya śrautasāvaśeṣena tannirā- karaṇaparatayā vyākhyātaḥ |
'nahi tasya guṇārthena' iti sūtrayavayatattvārthamanākalitaṃ bhāṣyakāreṇa |
nahi guṇādhi- karaṇavibaddhā pradeyatvena guṇavāśaṅkā jaiminermanasi saṃbhāvyate |
brīhivat pradeyaprakṛtitvenaiva tu śocitā |
taduktam--'yathaivākapālādau śraute'pi iti vākyataḥ |
brīhyādayo vidhīyante tathā somo vidyāsyate |
' iti |
(vā. pṛ. 513 ) |
atraike samādhānamabhidadhati--'āgneyo'ṣṭā- kapālo bhavati' iti atra agnidevatāsaṃbandhapuroḍāśa- pratipādakavākyaśeṣaḥ saṃbhavati |
'puroḍāśaṃ kūrmaṃ bhūtaṃ sarpantamapaśyan, tamabruvan, indrāya priyasva bṛhaspati priyasva viśvebhyo devebhyo priyasva' ityādi |
asya ca śrutiparatve'pi stutyapuroḍāśapratipādanāvarodhāt svavākya- khapuroḍāśe eva āgneyatvitparyavasānam |
tathā sati kiṃprakṛtikaḥ puroḍāśa iti prakṛtidravyapekṣāyāṃ 'vrīhibhi- yajeta' iti yuktaḥ prakṛtitayā brīhīṇāṃ vidhiḥ |
atra tu 'aindravāyavaṃ gṛhṇāti' iti vākyaśeṣānavagamāt prakaraṇanirīkṣaṇena ca 'somaṃ punāti' iti saprakṛtitvetha rakhasya pratītastatraiva taddhitaparyavasānamiti prakṛtirūpāpekṣā- bhāvācca prakṛtitvena 'somena yajeta' iti somalatāvidhiḥ saṃbhavati |
na ca 'tvāṣṭraṃ pānīvattamalameta' ityatra yathā ālabhambha arthākṣiptasālamamātre taddhitaparyavasānam, tathā 'aindravāyavaṃ gṛhṇāti' ityatrāpi svavākye eva grahaṇākṣisa- grahamātre taddhitaparyavasānam |
anyavyatiśruteśca 'aṇvyā dhārayā gṛhṇāti' iti vākye gauṇaśabdasya anyabhi- cārigrahaṇaviśeṣāmidhāyakātvāt, anyabhiritopasthita- dravyasyaiva taddhitaparyavasānamiti vaktavyam |
yenānyapara- śabdo'nyato'prāptena arthākṣiptanyāyena abhidhānamiti vyutpatteḥ, paraṃmate ca nityaṃ śabdāśabdādisaṃbandhāt arthākṣiptasyāpi tadvācakaśabdakalpanātirekeṇa anvayāt prakaraṇe ca 'somaṃ punāti' iti anyaparaśabdonītasya somaśabdasyaiva pratītastatraiva paryavasānam |
na ca latāvacana- tvāt somaśabdasya 'somaṃ punāti' ityatra somaśabdo na rakhapara iti vācyam |
dravyadravyakalpanāparaṇāmidhāyakasyo- punātiśabdasya latāmamidhāyārānuṣapattau lākṣaṇikatva- prabhavasaraparatvasya avaśyamabhyupeyatvāt |
na ca prathamāva- gatasomaśabdānurodhena upunātiśabdaḥ eva lakṣaṇāśrayaṇāt somalatāṇārthatvaṃ vaktavyam |
upunātiśabdagatalakṣaṇayā somalatāsaṃbandhocitakriyāviśeṣe vinigamanāpramāṇā- bhāvāt |
somaśabde tu utpannasaṃbandhocitaprabhavasarasyaiva yogyatvādāsti vinigamanāyāḥ pramāṇamiti tadvaitava lakṣaṇeti |
evaṃ sati utpannapradhānakarmatve ca ubhayāpi somaśabdasya rakhaparatvāt kimandravāyava ityapekṣāyā anuṣaṅgāt somarasaḥ evaṃ saṃvadhyate |
na ca dhārāvākyavyavadhānanānuṣaṅgaḥ, tatrāpi kiṃ dhārayā gṛhṇītītyapekṣāyāṃ somarasasaṃbandhāt |
yathā 'yā te agnerajāśayā' ityanena saṃvaddhaṃ 'tanūḥ' iti padaṃ irāśayetaya na vyavadhīyate, tathaivāpi somarasasya na dhārāvākyena aindravāyavasaṃbandho vyavadhīyate iti |
tathāca sati somarase eva taddhitaśruteḥ paryavasānāt prakṛtidravyā- pekṣābhāvācca tatprakṛtitayā latāvidhiḥ saṃbhavati |
taduktam--'puroḍāśo hyanirūpitaprakṛtidravyatayā āgneyā- diṣu pratīyate iti yuktaṃ prakṛtidravyavinigamanā |

na cāviniyuktatvena somasya anaṅgatvāt- saṃskāratvam, 'somaṃ punāti' ityatra saprakṛtitvena avagatasya aindravāyavavākyeṣu viniyuktatvāt, saviśe- ṣaṇānyasya kāyopayogitvena tatsaṃbhave sati pratītimātro- payuktasya upalakṣaṇasya anyāvyatvāt |
viśiṣṭavidhau ca viśeṣaṇānāṃ aupādānikāṅgabhāvasya sarvatra sthitatvāt |
na ca aupādānikasya somāṅgabhāvasya kalpanīyatvāt, pratyakṣāṃ ca śrutau kalpanā'natrakāśāt, 'somena yajeta' iti pratyakṣaśruteśca aṅgabhāvapratipādakatvamiti vaktavyam |
yato'mibhyaṃśca yāge tadanuvādena somavidhirbhavyaḥ |
yāgābhivyaktiśca aindravāyavatadvitasya utpannavākyagata- somaviśiṣṭasaṃbandhapūrvikā, tatra viśiṣṭaviśeṣaṇaviśeṣa- yoraikyarūpyam, kintu ākāṅkṣāyogyatāvaśādevatā (tānvena) rasasyāṅgābhāvo na somāṅgabhāvamantareṇa saṃbhavatītyaupā- dānike somāṅgabhāve pṛthaksiddhe tadupajīvya somavidhiḥ pratyakṣo'pi akiñcitkara eveti |
na caivaṃ sati latāyāḥ api pradeyatvaprasaṅgaḥ |
nahi sarvatra viśiṣṭavidhau viśeṣaṇa- viśeṣayorekarūpyam, kintu ākāṅkṣāyogyatāvaśādevatātve- nodeśyatvameva |
tatrāpi rasasya pradeyatve'pi tatprakṛtitvenaiva somalatāsaṃbandha iti |
athavā somasya aviniyuktatve'pi aṅgabhūtaropakārakatayā abhipavāditānvena, vasta- syaiva viniyuktadopakārakatayā 'vatsamālameta' ityatra ālabhambhasaṃskāryatvam, ṛcāṃ vā yathā viniyuktastutyupa- kāritāyā sāmasaṃskāryatvam, svādhyāyasya vā paramata viniyuktatadupakārakatayā adhyayanasaṃskāryatvam |
nanu somasya aviniyuktatvena anaṅgatvāt anaṅgasya ca apratinidheyatvāt, 'yadi somaṃ na vindeyuḥ pūtīkā- nabhiṣuṇyuḥ' ityatra pūtīkānāṃbhāvavihitaṃ bhavet, na somapratinidhiniyamaḥ |
tathā sati pūtīkāpacāre tasya doṣopādānaṃ bhavet, na somasahasopādānam |
ato yuktaṃ somasahasopādānamayaṃ somavidhimiti vaiṣamyam |
somarasasya viniyuktatvena tacchadapūtīkāntargatatvenaniyama- pratinidhiniyama eva |
athavā anaṅgatve'pi somasya tatprakṛtikarasyaiva vihitatvena rasasyaiva rakhaprakṛtyai somasya śāstrārthatvāt, śāstrārthasya pratinidhitvayogāt somapratinidhiniyame'pi yukta eva, kimaṅgatā kariṣyati na ca guṇādhikaraṇanyāyena pradeyatvamapi āgneyatvam tatra hi 'vaiśvadevyāmikṣā' iti svavākyatatāmikṣā 'varodhāt punaḥ 'aindravāyavaṃ gṛhṇāti' ityādiṣūkti vākyeṣu rasasya apratītatvena vaiṣamyam |
ato yuktaṃ bhāṣyakārasya latāyāḥ pradeyatvādyuktiḥ |

na ahaḥśabdasya kratau rūḍhiḥ, api tu dine eva śakasya ṛtuviśeṣe niruḍha- lakṣaṇayā prayogāt |
ato lakṣaṇāyāṃ pramāṇābhāvāt dvādaśadinātmakatvavidhiraivāyam |
ataśca sāṃtapanīyā- nyāyena ( 5|1|17 ) atideśikālatvādvā sāṅgānāṃ dvādaśasutyānāṃ dvādaśadinasamāptyavāptaḥ |

sāhityena eka phalasādhanānāṃ dvādaśānāmapi sutyānāṃ tathācaiva tantreṇaiva niruktasaṃkhyākadīkṣopasadyutkaraṇopapatteḥ tadādyuccau pramāṇā- bhāvaḥ |
ataśca aupadeśikakālānurodhāt ādyadine eva niruktasaṃkhyākadīkṣopasadādikaṃ sasulyaṃ sarvaṃ samāpya dvādaśa sutyā ekaikasmindine kartavyāḥ |

apitu sarvapradhānānāṃ dvādaśadinātmakakāla- sādhyatvāt tatprakhyanyāyena nāmadheyameva dvādaśāhaśabdaḥ |

evaṃ ca ' ṣaṭtriṃśadaho vā epaḥ yad dvādaśāhaḥ ' iti liṅgamanupapadyate |

bhāṣyam— asti dvādaśāhaḥ, samūḍho vyūhaśca tatra vyūhaḥ ' aindravāyavāgrau prāyaṇīyodayanīyau, atheteṣa daśānamahāmaindravāyavāgraṃ prathamamahaḥ, atha śukrāgram, atha dve āgrayaṇe, athendravāyavāgram, atha dve śukrāgre, athā- grayaṇāgram, atha dve aindravāyavāgre ' iti |
tatra vyūha idaṃ samānamasti ' chandāṃsi vā anyonyasya lokamabhiyāyanti gāyatrī triṣṭubham ; triṣṭub jagatyāḥ ; jagatī gāyatryāḥ ' iti |
tatra sānti bhakṣapavamānaparidhikapālāni |
mahāstavāta ' bhakṣe ( omāloha eti pararūpam ) mā ( māṃ prati ) viśa dīrghāyutvāya śāṃtanuvāya, ehi vaso purovaso priyo me hudo'si, aśvinostvā bāhubhyāṃ sadyāsam, vasumdraṇas rudravadraṇas ādityavadraṇas ( iti padatrayaṃ savanatraye krameṇa yojyam ) soma deva te matividaḥ ; prātasvanasya mādhyandinasya savanasya tṛtīyasavanasya ( savanatraye yathāyathaṃ krameṇa yojanīyāni ) gāyatracchandasaḥ triṣṭupchandasa jagatīcchandasaḥ ( savanatraye krameṇa yojanīyāni trīṇi padāni ) agniṣṭa indrapītasya madhumata upahūtasyo pahuto bhakṣayāmi ' iti |
tathā pavamānaḥ ; ' iyeno'si gāyatracchandāḥ ; suparṇo'si triṣṭupchandāḥ ; saghā'si jagatīcchandāḥ ; anu tvā''gne svasti mā saṃpāraya ' iti ca |
tathā paridhayaḥ ; gāyatro madhyamaḥ paridhiḥ ; caitrame dakṣiṇaḥ ; jagata uttaraḥ iti |
tathā kapālāni, aṣṭā kapālaḥ prātasvana, ekādaśakapālo mādhyandinaḥ : dvādaśakapālastṛtīyasavanikaḥ iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ ; hi chandovyatikrame vyatikramo bhakṣamantrāṇāṃ bhakṣasya ca pavamānamantrāṇāṃ pavamānasya ca , tathā paridhīnāṃ kapālā- ca, athavā mantrāṇāṃ chandovyatikrama iti |

bhāṭṭa -- jyotiṣṭome eva 'upāsamai gāyatā naraḥ' śruti nityāṃ pratipadaṃ vidhāya 'yuvaṃ hi sthaḥ' svarvatī iti dvayoryajamānayoḥ pratipadaṃ kuryāt |
ete aṣṭramindvaḥ iti vahvayo yajamānebhyaḥ' iti śrutam |

yadyapi ca pṛthak vibhaktiśravaṇam, tathāpi havirādyadhikaraṇanyāyena (6|4|22) pākṣika- svābhāvena pratyekaṃ nimittatvārthavaśānāt pradhānabhūta- nimittatvānurodhena militayoreva dvitvabahutvayajamāna- svāvacchinnayoḥ nimittatvaṃ pratipādyate |
yadi tu ṣaṣṭhī, tadā adhikāritvākhyasaṃbandhānuvādikā satī svaiyarthyapari- hārārthaṃ padye'pi lakṣaṇāmaṅgīkṛtya lāghavāt dvitvaja- mānatvayoreka vyāsajyavṛttinimittatvaṃ pratipādyati, viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāve'pi vinigamanāvi rahāt |
evaṃ 'bahvayo yajamānebhyaḥ' iti tādarthyacaturthyā'pi adhikāri- svasaṃbandhānuvādikā uktavidhanimittatve lakṣaṇā |
ataśca na anyatarāvivākṣaprasaṅgaḥ |

na ca tatra nimittābhāvaḥ ākhyātena 'vasantevasante jyotiṣā yajeta' ityādina upādeyakartṛviśeṣaṇatvenoktasya ekatvasya vivakṣāyāṃ nityatvena jyotiṣṭome yathāśaktyapyanyasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt yadi eko na śakyatvāt, tadā dvitvabahutvamānakatvaprāpte pratipadidhānasaṃbhavāt |
athavā yajamānaśabdasya yāgakartṛ mātravacanatvaṃ patnyāmapi saṃbhavāt ādyavākye tāva- tstrīliṅgatve bādhakābhāvāt patnītve sa mantraḥ |
dvitīya vākye'pi pāśādhikaraṇanyāyena liṅgānurodhena prakaraṇa vādhānupapatteḥ |
yatyanuśāsane puṃliṅgasya strītvaratvā vagateḥ patnītve dvitīye mantraḥ |
nityā tu pratipa patyekatve |

upādānagato hi pratiṣedhaḥ kṛtyaḥ syāt ( pratiṣedhyāyāḥ pravṛtteḥ kṛtapravṛttyadhīnatvena kṛtardhvatvāt ) nādhikāragataḥ ( svatantratvāt tatra pravṛtteḥ ) ' na hiṃsyāt bhūtāni ' iti ca adhikārato'yaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ puruṣārthaḥ |

bhāṣyam-- uttamasamābhiḥ codanānimittaṃ dharmasya jñānamiti |
tat pratijñāmātroktam |
idānīṃ tasya nimittaṃ parīkṣyāmaha iti codaneti, anyadapīti |

ślokā-- ' pratijñāvyatirekeṇa bhāṣyakāreṇa yadyapi |
vakṣyamāṇā svapakṣasya yuktiḥ pūrvaṃ nidarśitā ||

bṛhatī-- tasya nimittaparīkṣīḥ iti hetvabhidhānā- vasaraḥ kathyate |
kathaṃ punaḥ kārye'tha codaneva nimittam ? anyasya pratyakṣāderasaṃbandhāt |
kathamasaṃbhavaḥ ( taduttara- sūtre vakṣyāmaḥ ) |
ṛju-- codanālakṣaṇasūtreṇa śrutyābhyāṃ vedārtha- svarūpam, tatra ca pramāṇaṃ pratijñātam |
tatra kiṃ svarūpaṃ tāvat medābhedatvena kathyatām, uta pramāṇapratijñāyāṃ hetuḥ iti saṃśaye pradhānatvāt svarūpasya, tadeva medābhedāmyāṃ kathanīyaṃ iti prāpte, medābhedanirṇayasya anapekṣatasamba- pekṣatvāt prāmāṇye hetvapekṣāmadhunā kathanīyaṃ iti sūtreṇa kathyate |
tathā ca bhāṣyam ' idānīṃ tasya nimittaṃ parīkṣyāmaha ' iti |
tasmāt anapekṣatvarūpaprāmāṇya- hetvabhidhānāvasarakathanaṃ sūtreṇa kriyate iti |
śā-- anena sūtreṇa codanālakhyasya nimittasya parī- kṣaṇaṃ asmin pāde vakṣyamāṇam ' athataḥ śeṣalakṣaṇam ' ' atha viśeṣalakṣaṇam ' itivat sūtragrahaṇārthamanukīrtyate |
candrikā-- ayamatra sūtrārthaḥ : tasya dharmasya jñāne yannimittaṃ pramāṇaṃ codanā'bhidhānam, tasya parīkṣīḥ parīkṣā kartavyatā iti |
' iṣu gatau ' ityasmādātoḥ ' iperinicchārthasya ' iti yuci vihite ' parevā ' iti kitanucorvikalpasmaraṇāt yujividhau paryaṣaṇā iti rūpaṃ kitanuvidhau tu parīkṣīḥ iti rūpaṃ sidhyati |
atra dharma- pramāṇaṃ parīkṣyaṃ na veti saṃdehe, pramāṇopadeśenaiva prameya- siddheḥ kiṃ parīkṣayā iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
nātra siddhavat lakṣaṇakathanamātraṃ kintu vicāraśāstratvādya sarvathā pramāṇaparīkṣā kartavyā iti siddhāntaḥ |

SSdinā bhāṇyāntaraṃ nirdiṣṭaṃ yathā 'vrīhīnavahantyāt' 'odanaṃ pacati' ityādi, tatra dhātvarthasya karaṇatvameva |
yatra tu tādṛśasthale aprāptakaraṇāntarasattvam, dhātvarthasya ca prakaraṇaprāptā dhātvarthānuvādamātram |
sādhutvasiddhayarthaṃ dhātuḥ |
na tu tadarthasya karaṇatvena anvayaḥ, na vā āśrayatvena, karmatvātirikta āśrayatvasya nirvaktumaśakyatvena bhāvanāyāṃ indrirūpakarmatvarūḍhāyāṃ homasyāpi karmatvena anvaye ekakarmakatvamaṅgāpatteḥ |
ata eva anekoddeśya-nimittakatvamede'pi ekakarmakatvañca dūṣakatābījamuktaṃ kaustubhādau |
ekakarmakatvaṃ ca na ekakarmakatvaṃ ekakarmakāśraya-karmakatvaṃ vā 'sarvebhyo darśapūrṇamāsau', 'ghaṭānaya' ānaya' ityādi tadanāpatteḥ |
tatra putrādiviśiṣṭakarmatvā-śrayaputrādīnāṃ vā anekatvāt |
nāpi ekakarmakatvāccheda-kakatvaṃ 'sarvebhyo darśapūrṇamāsau' ityādi 'vrīhīn prokṣati' ityādi ca tadanāpatteḥ |
tatra putravatputrādīnāṃ tadapūrva-sādhanatvānāṃ ca karmatā'vacchedakānāṃ bhedāt |
kintu ekabodhaviṣayatvakarmaparyāptipyadhikaraṇatā'vacchedakadharmatvaṃ ityuktaṃ kaustubhe |
nirūpakatveṣu ca sarvatra karmatvaparyāptipi-karaṇatā'vacchedakadharmāṇāṃ ekena padena ekasya samūhā-lambanātmakasya bodhasya jananāt ekakarmakatvopapattiḥ |
'adhvaryuyajamānau vācaṃ yacchataḥ' ityatra ca adhvaryuya-jamānatvayoḥ karmatvādhikaraṇatā'vacchedakayoḥ ekabodha-viṣayatvābhāvāt dvikarmakatvāpattiḥ, ataḥ paryāptīti |
tatra dvaṃdvatvavibhaktyā devatātvāderiva karmatvāderapi nyāyasya-vṛttitvābhāyāt tatparyāptipyadhikaraṇatā'vacchedakadharmasya adhvaryuyajamānobhayatvasya dvaṃdvayaikabodhaviṣayatvena eka-karmakatvopapatteḥ |
upapāditaṃ caitat kaustubhādau |
evaṃ 'śuklaṃ ghaṭamānaya' ityādau śuklasya ghaṭe abhedānvayāt padadvayena ghaṭapadenaiva vā śuklaguṇaviśiṣṭaghaṭalakṣaṇāt eka-karmakatvopapattiḥ |
evaṃ 'ghaṭaṃ paṭaṃ cānaya' ityādau itare-tarayogārthakakārūpatānusāreṇa dvitīyā'nta-padadvaye lakṣaṇayā tadupapattiḥ |
yathā ca sati nimitta-
dravyasthale uddeśyānekanimittakavākyamedesya dūṣakatābījaṃ ekakarmakatvabhaṅgāpattiḥ, tathā kaustubhe vyaktam |
tat siddhaṃ yatra dvitīyā''dinā bhāṇyāntaraṃ bhāvanāyāṃ anvaya-yogyamupāttam, tatra na dhātvarthasya karmatvam |
yatra tu tannimittam, dhātvarthasya ca ihasādhanatvaṃ pramāṇāntareṇa pratimitam, tatra svāśrayavidheyaguṇāntarasattve dhātvarthasya karmatvameva yathā 'dadhnā juhoti' ityādi |
na caivam 'juhvā juhoti' ityādi juhoteḥ sakarmakatvāt karmāntarāśrayasya-bhāvena bhāvanāyāḥ dvikarmakatvāpattiḥ, sakarmakasyāpi bhāvākhyāte iva karmāvacchedyopapatteḥ |
etādṛśe'pi viṣaye yadi tṛtīyā''ntanāmadheyaśravaṇaṃ tadā karaṇatvameva, yathā 'same darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta' 'uccaiḥ pravarṇayena' ityādi |
yatra tu tādṛśaguṇaśravaṇābhāvaḥ, tatra dhātvarthasyaiva karmatvena prayojanāntareṇa anuvādaḥ yathā vidvadākyayoḥ |
tadabhāve (prayojanāntarābhāve) tu 'tanunpātaṃ yajati' ityādi karmāntarameva ityādi prakāre vyaktam |
yatra tu neṣṭāsādhanatvaṃ pramitam, na vā svāśraye ca uddiṣṭādivat tṛtīyā''ntanāmadheyaśravaṇaṃ yathā 'somena yajeta' 'agni-hotraṃ juhoti' ityādi, tatra khavākye iṣṭaviśeṣaṇatvagame-'pi vidhitvena bhāvanāyāḥ iṣṭabhāvyatvamātrāt iṣṭa-sāmānyasyaiva tatra bhāvyatvamaṅgīkṛtya dhātvarthasya karaṇatva-meva |
'agnihotram' ityatra dvitīyā''pi tatra karaṇatva-lakṣaṇāthaiva iti sāṃpradāyikāḥ |
etādṛśe viṣaye samāna-padaśrutyā bhāvanāpekṣitaṃ karma dhātvartha eva sutarāṃ agnihotraṃ iti dvitīyā''ntaśravaṇe |
na ca iṣṭāsādhanatvena ajñātasya karmatvānupapattiḥ, anīpsitakarmatvena anvayopapatteḥ |
na ca vidheḥ pravartakatvavyāghātaḥ, vidhivagato'bhādhyatvajñānasya pravṛtti prati kāraṇatve'pi śābdabodhe iti akāraṇatvāt tadabhāve'pi homakarmakabhāvanā'vacchedānopapatteḥ |
na ca bhāvyatvena anvitasya tasya bhāṇyāntarānākāṅkṣatvāt phalavākye'pi svargasādhanatvenābhānāpattiḥ, sādhanatvena anvitasya arthāt vidhiyugatena kṛtisādhyatvajñānavat kṛtisādhyatvena buddhasyāpi vidheyapekṣā'nusāreṇa iṣṭaviśeṣa-sādhanatayā vākyāntareṇa viśvajinnyāyena vā bodhopapatteḥ |
ataḥ 'utpattivākye dhātvarthasyaiva karmatvena anvayaḥ' iti
dhātvarthasya bhāvanāyāṃ 2269 dhātvarthānavacchi
prābhākaroktamapi yuktaṃ iti tarkadattikā |
sarvathā siddhaṃ dhātvarthasya karmatvaracanāyāntarasaṃsargeṇa bhāvanāyāṃ prakāratā iti |
sāṃpradāyikāstu dhātunā svārthavṛttikarmatvakaraṇa-tvānyatarat lakṣaṇā pratipādyate |
tasya svanirūpakatva-svanirūpakodeyatvatvānyatarasaṃsargeṇa bhāvanāyāmanvayaḥ |
na tu karmatvāderapi saṃsargatvam |
tathātve 'prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārthe saha brūtaḥ' iti sāhityarūpānvayānuśāsana-vaiyarthyāpatteḥ |
nahi padārthānuśāsanapravṛttānāṃ teṣāṃ anvayānuśāsakaṃ yujyate |
ataḥ karmāvakaraṇatvādirāpā-nayo'pi vṛttyaiva padārthavidhayā bhāsate |
ata eva jyoti-ṣṭomena iti tṛtīyā''pi padārthavidhayā bhāsamānakaraṇa-tvānuvādikā iti saṃgacchate |
viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayoḥ prakāratayā bhāsamānakārakatvasya autsargikatvāt ityāhuḥ |
tat siddhaṃ dhātvarthasya sarvatra bhāvanāyāṃ prakāratā |
sā paraṃ ākhyātopāttā kṛdāyupāttā ca liṅgānvayinī iti vakṣyate |
tena vastupadopāttāyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ nānyaḥ |

phūtkāravādika vinā- 'pi caitraniṣṭhakriyāntaratvāt svataḥ siddhajvalanā jāyamāne odane 'caitraḥ pacati' iti prayogācca |
tattvadvyāpārasya tattvenatattvena anubhave 'yāgaḥ icchā jñānaṃ vā' iti vādiviparītapatyanupatteśca |
ataḥ abhyupamamānaṃ pākatva- yāgādikameva tatphalapadhāyakatvāt vyāpārapacya- khaṇḍopādhirūpasāmānyā pacyādipadaśaktatā''vacchedakam |
tastattve 'pākaḥ pākaḥ' ityādyanugatapratītiḥ pramāṇam |
phalopadhāyakatā''vacchedakatayā śaktatā''vacchedakatvaiva vā tassiddhiḥ |
phalopadhāyakavyāpāratvādeḥ pramāṇāntarato bodhaḥ, na tu śābdabodhaḥ |
ata eva phalasyāpi na dvitīyayā bodhaḥ |
akhaṇḍopādhirūpakarmatvasya tadarthatayāḥ sthāpayiṣyamāṇa- tvāt |
śaktatā''vacchedakaṃ ca tattaddhātutvam |
pākatvādiphalaṃ ca viklittijanakavyāpāratveva, na tu tādṛśanādividhayapi |
'pākaṃ karoti' ityādinā yanādeḥ pākāt pṛthak vidriyamāṇatvāt |
na ca ghaṭādisamabhivyāhṛtadhātoḥ phale eva śaktikalpanāt pṛthak vivaraṇepattiḥ, anekaśakti- kalpane vyāpāraviṣayakaśaktipratītidhavakalpane vā gauravāt |
'grāmo gamanavān' iti pratītyāpattibhayena vyāpāra- pratīterapi āvaśyakatvāt |
ata eva viklittijanaka- vyāpārasamūha eva pākapadārthaḥ, na tu tajjanakatvanādirāpi, tasya pṛthak vidriyamāṇatvena parthyatvābhāvāt |
ata eva 'tejaḥsaṃyogāmātraṃ pacyathaḥ, na tu viklityanukūlavyāpāra- sāmānyam' ityapi pratyuktam |
agnisaṃyogāānukūlatvabhāva- vatyapi bhaktaviklityanukūlatvāvakartati 'pacati' iti prayogāt |
ata eva pākāt pṛthak vidriyamāṇatvādeḥ bhāsamānasya bhānakāraṇajijñāsāyāṃ pariśeṣyāt ākhyātā- rthatvameva |
tasmiṃśca pākādeḥ prakāratvaṃ prakṛtyarthatvādeva |
evaṃ ca pratyayārthādhānyasmṛtirapi na saṃkocitā bhavati |

sati ca tayoḥ bhinnārthatve tadarthapratipādanāya vyāsasamāsayoḥ svabhāvasiddhatvāt vibhāṣāvacanaṃ ( na ) kartavyaṃ ityupapannam |
ata eva 'ṛddhasya rājaḥ puruṣaḥ' ityatra samāso na prayujyate, bhinnārthatvāt |

ata eva ca rāja- puruṣa ityatra rājaḥ puruṣa iti vā rājñā puruṣa iti vā dvivacanabahutvayorapratīteḥ vṛttau ekatvamautsargika ityupa- pannam |

ataḥ paryudāsapakṣe samāsaprasaṅgāt anūyājeṣu iti syāt |
