ataḥ kathamekasmin puruṣe śākhā'ntarasya aprāmāṇya- mityucyate |
syādevaṃ yadi adhyayanavidheḥ prāk svādhyāya- syārthatvaniścayo bhavet, kintu lokānusāreṇa śaktya- vadhāraṇamātram |
adhyayanavidhistu uccāraṇatātparyādhīna- marthaparatvamiti arthavādādhikaraṇe eva prapañcitam |
tena lokānusāreṇa śakyavadhāraṇe jāte'pi uccāraṇatātparyama- ntareṇa svādhyāyasya arthaparatvaniścayāya sāmarthyaviniyukta- svādhyāyoddeśena adhyayanasaṃskāravidhiḥ; kintu svādhyāya- karmaikyaiva adhyayanasyārthajñānaṃ prati upādīyamānāt svādhyāyasyāpi upādeyatvamiti tadvatamekāvaṃ vivakṣita- meveti ekaiva śākhā ekasyādhyetuḥ pramāṇamiti nābhyāsāt karmabheda iti |
vedāntarīyaśākhādhyayanaṃ tu vacana- vaśādeva |
na caivaṃ vedāntarīyaśākhāvatagnihotrādikarmaṇāṃ abhyāsādvedaprasaṅgaḥ, samuccayāpādakavacanavaśena sutarām- bhedāvagateḥ |
tathāhi, karmāvabodhaṃ prati upādīya- māna eva samuccīyate ityekaḥ karmaprayogaḥ |
tadvatasāhityāthai trivedīmedo'tra ekasminneva karmaṇi vedabhedena samuccayā- bhagamāt |
etena prakaraṇāntaraguṇābhyo'pi bhedakatvaṃ prayuktā- meva |
kāṭhakādisaṃjñā tu na karmaṇaḥ, kintu kaṭhena proktamiti pravacananimittā hi sā |
na ca karma procyate, kiṃ tarhi ? grantha eva |
bhavatu vā karmaṇaḥ saṃjñā, tathāpi utpattisaṃyoginī hi saṃjñā meḍikā |
taduktam 'saṃjñā copattisaṃyogān' iti |
na ceyaṃ tatheti na karmabhedikā |
liṅgadarśanāni tu sūtrabhāṣyāvārtikānāṃ vāreṇa karmaikyā- virodhena vyākhyāsyeti |
taduktam 'tasmāttadeveti mate na karma bhinnaṃ kathañcittiśākhāmiṣṭam |
na kāraṇaṃ saptamamasti cānyato yathoktaiśca tu bhedasiddhiḥ |
' iti |
(vā. pṛ. 646) |
prayojanam - pūrvapakṣe yathā- śāstraṃ vyatrasthitajñānānuṣṭhānam |
siddhānte tu sarvaśāstrā- vihitānuṣṭhānamiti |
sūtraṃ tu - ekameva karmaphala- saṃyogāt dravyadevatātparyabhāvāvavidhyisaṃjñānā- maviśeṣāt pratyabhijñāsphuṭatvādityarthaḥ |
tautā. nāma-rūpa-dharmaviśeṣa-punarukti-nindā- aśakti-samāptivacana-prāyaścitta-anyārthadarśanāt śākhā'ntare karmabhedaḥ syāt |
pūrvapakṣeṇa śabdāntarābhyāsasaṃkhyāsaṃyogaprakaraṇānta- rāṇi ṣaṭ karmabhedakāni pramāṇānyuktāni |
uttarādhikaraṇe tu anyānyapi kānicit bhedakāraṇāni āśaṅkya nirā- karoti |
tatra bhedakāraṇāntaraśodhakaṃ pūrvapakṣasūtramidam |
tatra nāmabhedāt karmabhedaḥ |
kāṭhakaṃ eka kālāpakaṃ anyat |
tasmāt kāṭhakaṃ kaṭhāśākhoktamagnihotraṃ kālāpakā- gnihotrāt bhinnaṃ syāt |
ekatve ubhayatra vidhānārthakatham |
rūpabhedāt karmabhedaḥ |
ekasyāṃ śākhāyāṃ abhī- pomīyamekādaśakapālamāmananti, anyasyāṃ dvādaśakapālam |
evaṃ bhinnarūpāt karmaṇo bhedaḥ |
dharmaviśeṣāt karmabhedaḥ |
'māratamasi mahatāmojaḥ |
' ityādi kārīriṣṭimantrāśca adhīyānāḥ taittirīyāḥ; bodhā- yanasūtrānāusāriṇaḥ bhūmau bhojanamācaranti, bodhāyanīyebhyo- 'nye tu taittirīyāḥ kārīriṣṭimadhīyānā api bhūmibhojanaṃ nācaranti |
tasmādetādṛśāt dharmaviśeṣāt dharmabhedāt karmāpi bhidyate |
punarukteḥ karmabhedaḥ |
agnihotrādi karma pratiśālaṃ pratipādyate |
karmaikye tu iyaṃ pratiśālaṃ punaruktiḥ nopa- padyeta |
tasmāt punaruktyā abhyāsena karmabhedaḥ sidhyati |
nindayā karmabhedaḥ |
'udite hotavyam' iti prastute anuditahomaḥ |
nityate 'prātaḥprātaranṛtaṃ te vadanti puro- dayājjuhati ye'gnihotram |
' divākīrtyamadivā kīrtayantaḥ sūryo jyotireṣām |
' iti anudite sūrye 'sūryo jyotirjyotiḥ sūryaḥ svāhā' ityamidhānaṃ anṛtaṃ saṃpadyate ityarthaḥ |
anyasyāṃ tu śākhāyāṃ anudita- homaprastāve uditahomo nindyate 'yadudite sūrye prātarjuhuyāt |
yadā'tithaye pradāya svādhyāyātrāvasyā- hāya haranti |
tāhetra tat' |
asyāyamarthaḥ - 'agni vāva ādityaḥ sāyaṃ praviśati |
uyantaṃ vāva ādityaṃ agnirna samārohati' iti pūrvamuktam |
ato yajamānasya gṛhe sūryaḥ agni praviṣṭaḥ rātrau vasati |
udayakāle tu agniṃ vihāya gacchati |
tataśca yathā atithaye pradāya vaimukhyena gṛhāt dūrāt gatāya āhāryamannaṃ śūnyāya āva- sathāya atithigṛhe śūnye gṛhe samayarthaṃ caturthyau |
kiṃvā atithiśśūnyāya kevalayaiva jaḍāya gṛhāya dātavyam, tādṛk sa uditahomaḥ saṃpadyate |
iti |
tasmāt ubhaya- nindayā uditānuditahomau bhinnau bhavataḥ |
evaṃ nindayā karmabhedaḥ |
aśaktyā karmabhedaḥ |
dātavyo vedaśākhāsu vihitānāṃ bhinnabhinnanāmantrāṇāmekasmin karmaṇi upasaṃhāre manuṣyasya na śaktiḥ |
karmabhede tu kathaṃcit saṃbhavati |
samāptivacanabhedena karmabhedaḥ |
maitrāyaṇīśākhāyāṃ agnicayanamantrasamāmnāye anyārohā nāma sthaṇḍilā- rohaṇamantraviśeṣā anyatra paṭhyante |
kacit śākhāyāṃ tu na te mantrāḥ santi |
tatra adhyetāro yājñikāśca itthaṃ vyapa- diśanti anyāroheṣu maitrāyaṇīyānāmagniḥ samāpyate, itareṣāṃ tu anyatra samāpyate iti |
tasmādapi karmabhedaḥ |
prāyaścittabhedāt karmabhedaḥ |
kecit uditahoma- vyatikrame prāyaścittamāmananti 'yasyāgnihotramahutaṃ sūryo'bhyudiyāt' ityādinā |
anuditahome'pi |
gṛhyate hi prāyaścittam |
na ca karmaikye ubhayathā vṛddhiḥ saṃbhavati |
tasmāt karmabhedaḥ |
atha anyārthadarśanena karmabhedakam |
yathā kaci- cchākhāyāṃ dvādaśāhasatre śrūyate 'yadi purā dīkṣāṇā etameva bṛhatsāmānamupeyuḥ upetaṃ hyeṣāṃ rathaṃtaram |
atha yadi adīkṣāṇā rathaṃtarasāmānamupeyuḥ' |
iti |
yadi purā pūrvai dīkṣāṇāḥ dīkṣāvantaḥ kṛtaprathamasomāḥ syuḥ, tadā etameva atirātraṃ bṛhatsāmānaṃ upeyuḥ |
hi yassāt prathamasome rathaṃtaramemiḥ prayuktam |
yadi tu adīkṣāṇāḥ akṛtaprathamasomāḥ, tadā rathaṃtarasāmānamupeyuḥ |
'na rathaṃtarasāmānamuktvā bṛhatsāmānamāharet' iti niyamāt |
tadidaṃ aniṣṭaprathamasomānāpi dvādaśāhasatravacanaṃ prati- śākhaṃ karmabhedagamayati |
atha dvitīyamanyārthadarśanam |
taittirīyake yūpaikādaśinyāṃ śrūyate 'yat pakṣasaṃbhitāṃ minuyāt kanīyāsaṃ yaśakratumupeyāt, pāpīyasī asyātmanaḥ prajā syāt |
vedisaṃmitāṃ minoti, jyāyāṃsameva yaśakratu- mupaiti, nāsyātmanaḥ pāpīyasī prajā bhavati' iti |
pakṣaḥ agnicayanavederyaḥ pakṣaḥ, taṃ sagaśo daśā vibhajya madhye agniṣṭaṃ yūpaṃ pārśvayośca pakṣapañca iti ekādaśayūpapaṅkti yadi nilametat tathā kanīyāsaṃ alpataraṃ yaśakratuṃ prāpnuyāt, kiñca asya yajamānasya ātmanaḥ sakāśāt pāpīyasī daridratarā prajā bhavati |
tasmāt vedisaṃmitāt agniveda- pūrvādhaitaryakramaṇaṃ daśāśaṃ sama vibhajya pūrvavat yūpaikā- daśinīṃ minuyāt, tena yajñādeḥ jyāyastvasiddhiḥ |
seyaṃ pakṣasaṃmitāyāḥ nindā, vedisaṃmitāyāśca stutiḥ śākhāntare karmabhedaṃ gamayati |
atha tṛtīyamanyārthadarśanam - jyoti-
ṣṭomātirātre 'dve saṃstutānāṃ virājo'tiricyate' iti, śāstrāntare tu 'tisraḥ saṃstutānāṃ virājo'tiricyate' iti śrūyate |
saṃstutāḥ stotrāḥ |
virāṭ iti ekamekaṃ vā daśakaṃ gṛhyate |
so'yaṃ dvayostisṛṇāṃ vā atirekaḥ śāstrā- ntareṣu karmabhede ekaḥ saṃbhavati iti |
atha caturthama- nyārthadarśanam- sārasvate satre śrūyate 'ye puroḍāśinaḥ te upavasanti, ye sānāyinaste vatsān dhārayanti' iti |
ye yajamānāḥ puroḍāśinaḥ aniṣṭhaprathamasomatayā kevala- ndrāmapuroḍāśadravyakadarśoddiṣṭavantaḥ |
ye tu sānāyinaḥ iṣṭa- prathamasomāḥ |
te vatsān dhārayanti mātṛsakāśāṃ na gamayanti dohāya |
tadidaṃ aniṣṭhaprathamasomānāpi sārakhatasatradarśanaṃ karmabhedaṃ gamayati |
atha pañcamam- upahavye nāma some 'agniṣṭomo rathaṃtarasāmā, aśvaḥ śyāvo dakṣiṇā' ityekasyāṃ śālāyāṃ śrutam, śāstrāntare tu 'upahavya ukthyo bṛhatsāmā, aśvaḥ śveto dakṣiṇā' iti śrutam |
tacca śālābhedena karmabhede evopapadyate, na karmabhede |
tadeva nāmādibhiḥ kāraṇaiḥ śākhāntare bhinnāsu śākhāsu uktānāṃ karmaṇāṃ bhedaḥ syāt |
ekaṃ vā saṃyogarūpacodanā''khyā'viśeṣāt |
nāmarūpadharmaviśeṣadibhiḥ agnihotrādikarmaṇāṃ bhedaḥ iti pūrvapakṣaṃ bādhayate |
nāmādibhedena śākhā'ntareṣu na karmabhedaḥ |
kintu sarvaśākhāpratyayaṃ sarva- brāhmaṇapratyayaṃ ca ekaṃ karma saṃyogasya rūpasya codanāyāḥ ākhyāyāśca aviśeṣāt amedāt |
tatra saṃyogaḥ prayojanasya |
ekasyāṃ śālāyāṃ agnihotrasya karmaṇo yat phalaṃ svargaḥ, tadeva anyasyāmapi śākhāyāmuddiṣṭam |
eva- mekaphalakatvāt sarvāsu śākhāsu ekamevāgnihotraṃ karmeti jñāyate |
evaṃ somarendrayāgvādindradevatākasya karma- rūpasya abhedo bhavati śākhābhede'pi |
evaṃ yajeta iti bātvarthāṃturūpabhāvanātmikāyāḥ codanāyāḥ sarva- śākhāsu viśeṣaḥ |
jyotiṣṭomādisamākhyāyāśca śālā- bhede'pi na viśeṣaḥ |
tasmāt śākhābhede'pi saṃyoga- rūpacodanākhyānāṃ bhedābhāvāt śākhābhede'pi agnihotrasya
karmaṇo na bhedaḥ |
evaṃ jyotiṣṭomāderapi abhedo jñeyaḥ |
tathā ca sarvaśākhāpratyayamekaṃ karma |
na nāmnā syāccodanā'bhidhānatvāt |
yaduktaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇā kāṭhakakālāpakādināmabhedāt karma- bheda iti tannāha siddhāntī |
bhinnaināpi īdṛśena nāmnā na karmabhedaḥ syāt |
acodanā'bhidhānatvāt, codanā karmotpattivākyam |
tadgatamabhidhānaṃ nāmadheyaṃ codanā- bhidhānam |
tādṛśābhāvāt kāṭhakādināmnaḥ |
utpatti- vākyagatā saṃjñā karma bhinatti |
kāṭhakādisaṃjñā tu notpattivākyagatā |
ato na sā karma bhetuṃ śaknoti |
tathā ca kāṭhakādināmnā na karmabhedaḥ |
sarveṣāṃ caikakarmyaṃ syāt |
kāṭhakādināmnā na karmabheda ityatra hetvantaramāha |
yadi śabdabhedāt bhedo bhavet, tarhi śabdaikyāt karmaikyaṃ syāt |
tathā ca kāṭhakakāṇḍasthānāṃ sarveṣāṃ agnihotradarśapūrṇamāsajyotiṣṭomānāṃ karmaṇāṃ aikakarmyaṃ syāt |
taccāniṣṭam |
kṛtakaṃ cābhidhānam |
kāṭhakādināmabhedāt na karmabhedaḥ ityatra hetvantara- māha siddhāntī |
kāṭhakādi abhidhānaṃ kṛtakaṃ idānī- ntanam |
yataḥ prabhṛti kasya prakṛtaṃ vacanaṃ tataḥ prabhṛti kāṭhakaṃ iti nāma pravṛttam |
na ca kṛtakena anādīnāṃ karmaṇāṃ bhedaḥ kartuṃ śakyate |
tasmāt na nāmnā bhedaḥ |
ekatve'pi param |
rūpabhedāt karmabhedaḥ iti yaduktaṃ tatrottaramāha siddhāntī |
ekatve'pi karmakāle satyapi paramuttaraṃ karma- bhedakāraṇatvena pūrvapakṣiṇā uktaṃ saṃbhavati |
karmatve'pi vacanāt brīhiyavatvat vikalpena agnīṣomīyasya puroḍāśasya ekādaśakapālavadvādaśakapālayorupapattiḥ |
tasmāt na rūpabhedāt karmabhedaḥ |
vidyāyāṃ dharmaśāstram |
bhūmibhojanādidharmaviśeṣāt karmabheda iti yaduktaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇā tatrottaramāha siddhāntī |
dharmaśāstraṃ kārīrī- vākyādhyayanakāle bhūmibhojanādivitodeśakaṃ vidyāyām,
na karmaṇi |
adhyayanadharmaḥ eṣaḥ na karmadharmaḥ |
ato na tena karmabhedaḥ seddhumarhati |
āgneyavat punarvacanam |
punaruktyā karmabhedaḥ iti yaduktaṃ tatrottaramāha siddhāntī |
punarvacanaṃ śākhā'ntare vihitasya sāṅkasya jyotiṣṭomādeḥ karmaṇaḥ anyasyāṃ śākhāyāṃ punaruktiḥ vidyamānāpi āgneyavat na karmabhedikā |
'yadāgneyo'ṣṭā- kapāle'māvāsyāyāṃ bhavati' iti punarvacanaṃ aindrāga- stulyatvāt yathā na karmabhedasya kāraṇaṃ tadvat |
advairvacanaṃ vā śrutisaṃyogāviśeṣāt |
punaruktyā karmabhedaḥ iti yaduktaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇā tatra bhadvyantareṇottaramāha siddhāntī |
vāśabdaḥ prakārānta- rārthe |
advairvacanaṃ naiva tat dvivacanam |
naiva sā puna- ruktiḥ |
ekaṃ puruṣaṃ prati punaḥpunaḥ kathane syāt puna- ruktiḥ |
bhinnaṃ puruṣaṃ prati punarvacane tu naiva sā puna- ruktināma |
śrutisaṃyogāviśeṣāt bhinnaiḥ puruṣaiḥ saha tattacchākhāyāḥ saṃyogāt |
śrutisaṃyogasya bhinnaiḥ puruṣaiḥ saha tattacchākhāyāḥ saṃyogasya viśeṣatvāt |
tasmāt tatta- cchākhāsu agnihotrādikarmaṇaḥ bhinnaṃ puruṣaṃ prati uktiḥ na dvivacanaṃ na dviruktiḥ na punaruktiḥ |
tasmāt tādṛśyā punaruktyā na karmabhedaḥ |
vākyāsamavāyāt |
atra vārtikam "atrāntare bhāṣyakārasya sūtraṃ aṣṭam 'vākyāsamavāyāt' iti |
edavaṃ vyākhyātavyam, 'naikasmin puruṣe śālā'ntaravākyaṃ samavaiti' iti |
tathā ca vākyasya śālā'ntaravākyasya ekasmin puruṣe asamāvāyāt saṃbandhābhāvāt paunaruktyam |
tasmāt paunaruktyābhāvādeva pūrvapakṣiṇā yaduktaṃ punaruktyā karmabheda iti tat mūlata eva nirastam |
arthāsaṃnidheyaśca |
arthyate pradhānena iti arthaḥ aṅgākāṇḍam |
tasya sarvasya aṅgākāṇḍasya ekasyāṃ śākhāyāmasaṃnidheḥ saṃnidhe- rabhāvāt ekaikasyāṃ śākhāyāṃ keṣāṃcideva aṅgānāṃ vidhānāt sarvāsu śākhāsu militvā ekaikaṃ karma ucyate iti sarvaśākhāpratyayamekaṃ karma |
iti siddhānte hetvantaraṃ
sūtram |
'athavā paunaruktyaparihārārthameva sūtram |
tatra nāma punaruktā bhavati, yatra pūrvokto'rthaḥ tasyaiva puṃsaḥ saṃnihito bhavati |
na tu iha śākhā'ntaragatasya saṃnidhānaṃ ityapunaruktā' iti vārtikam |
na caikaṃ prati śiṣyate |
caśabdaḥ samuccaye |
śākhābhedeṣu ekasyāpi karmaṇaḥ punaḥpunarukteḥ karmabhedaḥ iti yaduktaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇā tat nirasyati vidhāntareṇa siddhāntī |
agnihotrādi karma pratiṣṭhānaṃ naikameva puruṣaṃ prati śiṣyate vidhīyate |
kintu arthamātraṃ prati sarvaśākhāsu vidhīyamānaṃ ekamekaṃ puruṣa- mupatiṣṭhate |
tatra ekasya anekaśākhāśravaṇāt punarvacanataḥ pratiṣṭhānaṃ karmabhede ekārthatvāt samuccayānupapattau vikalpaḥ syāt |
tato varaṃ pratyabhijñā karmaikye sati śākhānāmeva puruṣavyavasthā tadāśrayaṇaṃ iti ekasya anekaśākhā- 'dhyayanāsaṃbhavāt na punaruktiḥ |
samāptivacca saṃpraśnaḥ |
karmabhedahetuṃ samāptivacananirāsārthameva sūtram |
nahi pratiśākhaṃ sāṅgopāṅgamekaṃ karma paṭhitam |
kvacit kānicidaṅgāni anyatra tato nyunāni vā adhikāni vā paṭhyante |
tatra yatra yāvat paṭhitam, tatraiva tacchākhāyāṃ tat karma samāptam |
saṃpraśnā upadeśo'pi 'atrāsmākaṃ karma samāpyate' ityevaṃrūpaḥ |
tatra bhavati |
na ca tāvatā tāvadeva tat karma iti niścetavyam |
aita- reyake hi dvādaśāhagatāni hotṛdevaya śastrāṇyukāni na maitrāvaruṇādīnām |
na ca tāvatā maitrāvaruṇādīnāṃ śākhāṇi naiva santīti vaktuṃ yuktam |
tathāca yathā samāptiḥ ani- yatā tathā saṃpraśna'pi aniyataiveti kramaprāptam |
sarvathā- 'pi samāptivat saṃpraśna'pi na karmabhediketi niścetuṃ śakyate |
atra vārtikam- asamāvita iti cchedaḥ |
( na caikaṃ prati śiṣyate samāptivat iti susaṃhitāyāṃ akārapraśleṣeṇāpi vicchedasaṃbhavaḥ |
iti sudhā |
ekatve'pi parāṇi nindā'śaktisamāpti- vacanāni |
pūrvapakṣiṇā karmabhedakāni yāni uktāni tatra nindā- 'śakti dvitrayaṃ karmabhedamādayoḥ samānatvāt nāhya bhedasādhaka-
mityāha siddhāntī |
parāṇi punarukaiḥ parastāt paṭhitāni nindā ca aśaktiśca samāptivacanaṃ ceti trīṇi karmaṇā- mekāve'pi upapannāni iti na bhedasādhakāni |
tathāhi, nahi nindā ninyaṃ nindituṃ prayujyate kiṃ tarhi ninditā- ditarat praśaṃsitum |

santi tu prakṛtau nāriṣṭhahomāḥ : 'nāriṣṭhān homān juhoti' iti |

asti prakṛtau 'nīvītaṃ manuṣyāṇām, prācīnāvītaṃ pitṛṇām, upavītaṃ devānām, upavyayate devatvameva tat kurute' iti |

nāriṣṭhahomādīnāṃ 2330 nikāya:
tatrakālatvāt atra śabdabalena pradhānottarabhāvināmeṣāṃ samānasthānakatvena ekakāryajanakatvāttaḥ upadiṣṭarūpomeḥ nāriṣṭhahomānāṃ atidiṣṭānāṃ śaravat bādhaḥ iti prāpte |
śarā hi barhiḥśabdalakṣitaistatkāryai vihitāḥ yuktaṃ yat tatkāryapṛṣṭhabhāvena prāpyamānaṃ barhirdharmāt, upahomāstu nāriṣṭhahomākāryatvenā ityatra na kiñcit pramāṇamasti, pratyakṣādestāvat adṛṣṭārtheṣu apravṛtteḥ |
na ca samāna- sthānakatvāt ekakāryatvāttaḥ upahomātrākye atideśa- prāpitanāriṣṭhakāryasya upasthāpakapadābhāvena anuddeśyatvāt taduddeśena upahomavidhivyapattīteḥ atideśena kāryadravyabhāvena nāriṣṭhanāmāpi prāpyapyapyatastat śaranyāyavailakṣyeṇa samāna- sthānakatvamātrasya aprayojakatvāt |
na ca upahomāvākye karmāntaravidhāveva pramāṇābhāvaḥ, nāriṣṭhānuvādenaiva mantra- vidhānopapatteḥ iti vācyam |
prāptakramādeta aneka- mantravidhau vākyabhedāpādakaguṇasyaiva bhedakatvāt |
ekaṃ hīdaṃ vākyaṃ itikaraṇena taittirīyaśāstrājñātena mantrāṇāṃ juhotāveva anvayapratīteḥ |
ata eva svāhākārāntānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ liṅgādeva nāriṣṭhahome viniyogaprasaktau punaḥ viniyogāntaravaiyarthyaprasaṅgādapi karmāntaram, tacca eka- vākyopādānādavagatasahākārāntamantrasamuccayabalena anekaṃ āśaṅkate vā ityanyadetat |
na ca tathāpi upadiṣṭahomaireva vikṛteḥ nirākāṅkṣatvāt atideśakalpakatvābhāvena nāriṣṭhā- prāptiḥ |
upahomānāṃ aklṛptopakārakatayā upakārakā- kakṣiṇyā vikṛtyā prathamaṃ atideśikasyaiva grahaṇena nāriṣṭhānāṃ prāpyapyapyateḥ |
ata eva upahomādīnāṃ vaikṛtānāṃ anyatarākāṅkṣayaiva grahaṇaṃ anupasthitaphalāntarakalpane gauravāt |
ata eva yatra klṛptopakārakaprākṛtāne punaḥ- śravaṇaṃ vikṛtiprakaraṇe, yathā gameṣṭīyayājyādau tatraiva vikṛteḥ nirākāṅkṣatvāpādanena atideśalopaḥ |
yatra vā saṃniptopakārakakāṅkṣasāmagrīvaikalpyam |
na tu atra dravyamapyasti |
ataḥ upahomaiḥ nāriṣṭhānāṃ na bādhaḥ |
yat atra bhāṣyakāreṇa śyene 'nīvītā ṛtvijaḥ pracaranti' ityāmnānena prayogāṅgabhūtakartṛsaṃskārakeṇa nīvītena atideśaprāptasya sarvakarmārthatvena vihitasya cogravītasya bādhamāśaṅkaya adṛṣṭārthatvāt samuccaya iti siddhāntitam |
tadasya adṛṣṭārthatve śrāddhādāvapi prācīnāvītena saha upavītasya samuccayapatteḥ yāvajjīvaikaśrutivattanavatakasyo- pavītadhāraṇāśritaprakāraviśeṣasya upavītatvānivītatvādeḥ tattatkarmajñatayā vihitasya samuccayasaṃbhavāt upekṣitam |
yadyapi 'saṃsthite baddhe madhyāśayet' iti vihita- madhyāśanena prākṛtaprayogavat tasminnahani nivṛttimāśaṅkaya adṛṣṭārthatvādeva samuccaya ityuktam |

atha nigadā nāma kiṃ yajūṃṣi ? uta yajurmoḍanye ? iti ṛksāmayajuḥ śabdapadeṣu nirūpiteṣu nigadānāmanu- prasaṅgenaiva 'uccairnigadena' ityevamādidevavākyagata- nigadapadāryau nirūpyate |
atrāyaṃ pūrvapakṣo'bhisaṃdhiḥ: 'upāṃśu yajuṣā' iti yajuṣāmupāṃśudharmaśālitvaṃ pratīyate |
asya ca 'uccairnigadena' iti viśeṣaḥ śrūyate |
sa cāsya yajuṣe nopapadyate, vidhivyudādorasaṃbhavāt |
vidhivi sati 'upāṃśu yajuṣā' iti sāmānyaśāstraprāpta- mupāṃśutvaṃ 'uccairnigadena' iti viśeṣaśāstreṇa bādhanīyam |
bādhaśca gatyantarāsaṃbhave bhavet |
tena 'brāhmaṇebhyo dadhi dīyatāṃ takraṃ kauṇḍinyāya' ityatra kauṇḍinyagatabrāhmaṇatvasya pramāṇāntarasiddhatvāt bhavat gatyantarāsaṃbhavena bādhaḥ; yajuṣaśca pramāṇāntarasiddhatvāt 'śepe yajuḥśabdaḥ' iti lakṣaṇasya ṛksāmanigadadoṣaparatvenāpi saṃbhavāt tribhyo'- nyatvenaiva upapatterna bādhasaṃbhavaḥ |
na ca yajuṣe'pi parasaṃjñārūpatvena nigadānāṃ arthaprāptamuccaistvam 'uccai- rnigadena' ityevamate |
yajuṣṭve sati vācanikanopāṃśutvena arthaprāpta uccaistvasya bādhitatvāt anuvādāsaṃbhavāt |
kiñca, vyapadeśabhedāt abhimuktānāṃ dṛśyate 'nigadā vartante na yajūṃṣi, atha yajūṃṣi na nigadāḥ' iti |
ato na yajūṃṣi nigadāḥ, kintu caturthameva nigadā iti mantranāmatviti |
evaṃ prāpte, abhīdhīyate |
yajūṃṣi vā tadupatvāt |
ayamabhiprāyaḥ, bhavedevaṃ yadi 'uccairnigadena' ityatra anuvādo na saṃbhavet |
na ca yajuṣe sati arthaprāpta- muccaistvaṃ upāṃśutvavidhina bādhitāt nānucyate iti vācyam |
upāṃśutvavidherniyameṣu pravṛttasaṃbhavāt |
tathāhi, 'agnīn vihara barhistṛṇādi' ityevarūpā hi nigadāḥ |
te ca parasaṃjñārthatvena prayogapūcaryāmāṇeṣu svakāryakṣamā
bhavanti |

na ca dharmabhedāt bhedaḥ, viśeṣavihitena uccaistvena sāmānyavihitasya upāṃśu- tvasya anyaparatvātsyāt |

kāryābhidhāyitā tāvalliṅādīnāmavagatā ācāryavākyeṣu 'māṇavaka samidhamāhara' ityādiṣu |
tathāhi etadvākyaśravaṇānantaraṃ pravartamānaṃ samidāharaṇe māṇa- vakamupalabhya pārśvastho vyutpattirevamavadhārayati, buddhipūrvakaṃ asya pravṛttiḥ, svatantrapravṛttitvāt, madīyapravṛttivat |
ahaṃ yaccāhaṃ buddhvā pravṛttastadadeva madviśeṣāt |
ahaṃ ca na kriyāmātragavamāt nāpi phalamātratvagamāt, nāpi phalasādhanatvāvagamāt, kintu kāryatāvagamāt |
na khalva- nyato'bhekaḥ stanapānādikāmāpi kriyā yāvanmayā bhagavatavānasi na tāvat tasyāmapi pravṛttaḥ |
na ca yā śreyaḥsādhanatā saiva kāryatā, parasparaparihārasthitalakṣaṇa- virodhādhāratvāt |
nadyasti saṃbhavaḥ; yadeva samīhitaṃ prati sādhanatvam, tadeva kṛti puruṣaprayatnaṃ prati sādhyatvamiti |
kleśāmanastu karmaṇaḥ phalasādhanatā'nvayinī kāryatā iti kecit abhedaṃ pratītavantaḥ |
tathā sulabhya phalasādhanatāṃ vinā ca kāryatāvagatirasti |
ataḥ phalasādhanatā'ti- riktakāryabodhāt pravṛttirmameti māṇavako'pi tadava- bodhādeva pravṛtta iti niścinoti |
tadavabodhaścāsya ācāryavacanānantaramupajāyamānaḥ |
tannivandhana eveti kāryābhidhāyatāṃ śabdasya kalpayati |

na ca kriyā'nantaraṃ bhavadapi deśakālādisahakāryapekṣayā anantarameva svagādi bhāvayati |

śabdasāmye'pi kartavyatāmedāt atha- madoṣa iti cet ? na |

evaṃ ca naimittikeniṣedhādapūrvayoḥ nāpūrvasiddhiliṅādīnām |

avāntaravyāpārādedādīnāṃ sādhanānāṃ meda iti cet ? ihāpi upatyapūrvāṇyeva avā- ntaravyāpārāḥ |
te ca pratyāmeyādi bhidyante iti samānam |
evaṃca āgṇaupadhamānāyeṣu na saṃkaro dharmāṇām |
paramāpūrva- prayuktāve'pi avāntaravyāpārotpatyapūrvabhedena sādhanabhāvasya medāt apūrvasādhananiveśitatvāt ca teṣām |
anyathā tadamede saṃkaraprasaṅgāt |

niyogavākyārtha 2367 niyogavidhivādaḥ
upatyapūrvāṇi avāntaravyāpārāḥ śakyo vā tathā, phalaṃ prati avagatasādhanabhāvāḥ |
kriyāyāḥ avāntaravyāpāraḥ śaktirvā apūrve bhaviṣyati |
kathamanvasamavetā anyasya śaktiḥ, asati vā vyāpāravatī |
avāntaravyāpāra iti cet ? āgneyādīnāmapi paramāpūrvasādhanānāmavāntara- vyāpāreṣu śaktiśca tathācapūrvatve tulyatvāt paryantayogasya |
anapekṣaśabdāvagatasādhanabhāvānāṃ āgneyādīnāṃ asambhavā- manyasamavetānyapi asamānakālānyapi upatyapūrvāṇi vyāpārāḥ sāmarthye veti cet ? tat kim 'darśapūrṇa- māsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta' iti lokānusārataḥ sādhya- svargaviśiṣṭena kriyā kāryā nāvagamyate, svaviśeṣaṃ vā sādhyarūpaṃ pratyayasthānānukūlyam, yena tadaghaṭya avā- ntaravyāpāraḥ sāmarthye vā kriyāyā nāpūrvamāsīyeta ? phalasādhanasādhanaṃ na phalasādhanaṃ kriyeti mithyā, phala- pravṛttyā eva tasyāstatsādhanatvāt |
yathā paramāpūrva- sādhanapravṛttānāmāgneyādīnāṃ upatyapūrvasādhanatvam, sasthā- gamodeśena pravṛttasyaiva kṛṣikarmaṇo bhūpaṭanādisādhanatvam |
na ca paramāpūrve prati upatyapūrvāṇāmeva sādhanatvam, āgneyādīnāmiti sāṃpratam |
nahi 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyām' iti ca 'yajeta' iti cocyapūrvāṇāmabhidhānam, api tu paṇāmāgneyādīnāṃ kālaviśeṣasaṃbandhenopacānāṃ anu- ditānāṃ samudāyānām |
na caiṣāṃmupatyavyāpāreṇa yathārthaṃ upatyapūrvāṇi prati kāraṇatvamadhigamayitumīśate |

jalaṃ caitrāharasveti caitra āharate yadā |
tadā vyutpattisamāno''nyastatraivamavagacchati |
' buddhipūrvā pravṛttiriyamiti |
liṅadidhruvākyaśravaṇamātra- prayojyabuddhasya viśiṣṭārthaviṣayāṃ pravṛttiṃ dṛṣṭvā vyutpatti- māno bālaḥ : evamākalayati, 'yeyaṃ svādhīnā asya pravṛttiḥ, sā madabuddhipūrvikā' iti |
punaśca tasyāyaṃ vimarśo jāyate 'ahaṃ buddhvā pravṛtto yat tadepo'pi, yasyāḥ pravṛtterhetubhūtā buddhiḥ, sā yadviṣayā satī mama pravṛttihetuḥ, tadviṣayaivāsyāpi' iti nyutpattisoranumā jāyate |
tadevamanumānadvayamatat 'buddhasya svayameva pravṛttiḥ dharmiṇī, buddhipūrvikā iti sādhyo dharmaḥ |
svatantrapravṛtti- tvāt madīyasvatantrapravṛttavat' iti |
tathā 'buddhasya pravṛttihetubhūtā buddhiḥ dharmiṇī, yadviṣayā satī mama pravṛtti- hetubhūtā, tadat viṣayaivāsyāpi sādhyo dharmaḥ |
pravṛttihetu- bhūtabuddhitvāt madīyapravṛttihetubuddhivat' |
punaśca tasyāyaṃ vimarśaḥ pravartate |
padasya (yasya) tu śabdena bodhyate anena mama, mānāntareṇa tu yadviṣayā sā buddhiḥ pravṛttihetubhūtā, tadat svasthānena śabdena bodhyate, tadbhāve sati avagamāt |
mama tu mānāntareṇa tad bodhyate ityapa- māvayorviśeṣaḥ |
yena yat buddhyā pravṛttirmama, tadasthānena śabdena bodhyate iti śabdasya pravṛttihetubhūtātho bodhaka- tāmavadhārayati |
punaśca ko'sau pravṛttihetubhūtārthaḥ |
śabdābhidheyaḥ iti nirdhārituṃ svātmani pratipannaṃ pravṛttihetubhūtārthamanu- sandhatte - 'tatra buddhyā pravṛtto'haṃ kiṃ tāvat svayamanvayā' |
śabdanirapekṣaḥ svayamayaṃ pravartamānaḥ kiṃ buddhvā pravṛttaḥ iti jijñāsāste |
anyadetena vyutpattiḥ prāgavasyocyate |
anutpannena bālena yat ātmani pratītikārayatayā pratītim, tadeva vyutpannasyāpi tena kalpyate, nānyadityarthaḥ |
tena 'śabda eva pravṛttihetubhūto- vidhisadavyāpāre vā' iti nirastaṃ bhavati |
tayorvāle- nāmani pravṛttikāraṇatvena darśanāt |
atimandatayā cemī pakṣau na sākṣādupannasya nirasto |
tathāhi |
liṅādi- śabdasvarūpa pravartakatve sarve eva tacchāviṇo niyamena pravartairan, na caivaṃ dṛśyate, kaścit kadācit pravṛttiḥ |
liṅādidhyāpārasya tu pravṛttihetutvāśravaṇaṃ devāḥ pratipadyantām |
piśitacakṣuṣā mānuṣā vayaṃ netyeti pramāṇa- bhūmimavagāhtuṃ kṣamāḥ |
śabdabhāvanā liṅādidhyāpārarūpā puruṣapravṛttibhavanānukūlā svajñāpitakaraṇikā arthavādodita- prāśastyalakṣaṇā itikartavyatāyoginī preraṇā''tmikā kalpyate |
svādhyāyādhyayanavidhinā hi sarve vidhāyakāḥ svādhyāyaśabdavācyāḥ svātmā ca niyujyante bhāvayediti |
tatra kimityapekṣāyāṃ puruṣapravṛttiḥ saṃśrayate |
kenetyākāṅkṣāyāṃ vidhimānameva yogyatayā karaṇatvena aṅgīkriyate |
jñātā hi śabdabhāvanā pravṛtti prasṛte, yogyatayā eva arthavāda- samudyaprāśastyajñānaṃ itikartavyatātve niveśite |
avasī- dantī hi vidhivyāptiḥ prāśastyajñānena uttabhyate iti tasyāḥ puruṣavyāpārarūpagarbhādibhāvāvacchinnā bhāvārtha- karaṇikā śrautasārtācāraprāptapadārthārthagamajanitakaraṇopa- kāravatī arthabhāvanā samānapratyayavācyā viṣayabhūtā |
tatra liṅadesāhaśo vyāpāro vidyate ityatra na kiñcana
pramāṇam |
liṅadiśabdāntarabhāvinī pravṛttireva pramāṇa- miti cenna, tasminnacanatvena pravṛtteḥ anyatrādṛṣṭatvāt |
tannibandhana hi pravṛttirbhavati |
tadeva tad dṛṣṭvā śakyamanu- mātum |
na punarapratipannapūrvakāraṇabhāva (va-) śabda- vyāpāraviśeṣaḥ |
pṛ. 25-27.
liṅādiśabdañca eva pramāṇamiti sāhasam, agṛhīta- saṃbandhasya śabdasyāvācakatvāt |
anavadhārite hi saṃbandhini saṃbandhabodhavaidhuryāt |
yat ca tatra svādhyāyādhya- yanavidhinā sarve vidhāyakā ātmā ca niyujyante, puruṣaṃ hi vidhiḥ prerayati yaśca yena preryate te acetanā na yujyante na cācetanānāṃ niyogyatvamapi saṃbhavati |
aniyogyatve kiṃ tatra yujyate |
tadapyanupapannam |
śabda- bhāvanā sarvaśabdānāṃ svataḥ eva sakartṛtvāt viniyogā- napekṣatvāt |
atha na puruṣapreraṇe viniyujyante kiṃ tvartha- vibodhane |
tadapi na ghaṭate |
tatrāpi niyojanapekṣāyā- stulyatvāt |
adhyayanaviccheda akṣarasaṃskārarūpādhyayana- vidhāyakānābhyupagamaḥ |
tathā cāhuḥ 'dravyādīnāṃ punaḥ kasmin svādhyāyo'ntargato bhavet |
saṃskārye- gaṇanāyāṃ ca yuktaivākṣarasaṃsthitā |
svādhyāyo hi sphuṭaṃ karma sākṣātsaṃskriyate hi saḥ |
' iti saṃskāra- vidhiśca na saṃskārye niyujyate pramāṇāntarāvasitopayogasya śepitatvāt |
saṃskāraparyavasāyī tu saṃskāravidhirna saṃskāryasya kārye kalpyate |
ātmā cādhyayanavidhinā niyujyate viniyujyate veti pratipattidvayasyāpi asaṃbhavat anupapannam |
kathaṃ ca puruṣapravṛttiḥ |
tasyā bhāvyā |
na tāvadanantaraniṣpatteḥ |
vidhijanasya karaṇabhāvāve aprasa- ṅgāt |
kriyāphalaṃ hi tadā puruṣapravṛttiḥ syāt |
na ca kriyā svaphalaprathāya karaṇamapekṣate, na ca gamanaṃ saṃyoga- vibhāgārambhe karaṇāpekṣam |
syānmatam |
śabdo vidhi- jñānaṃ janayitvā tatkaraṇānugṛhītaḥ preraṇārūpaṃ svavyāpāramā- rabhate iti karaṇabhāvāvaḥ kriyāniṣpattāveva karaṇatvāt |
tadidamalaukikam |
nahi kasyacid vastunaḥ svajñāna- mutpādanahetuḥ iti pratītam |
evaṃ ca arthavādodita- prāśastyasyāpi itikartavyatātvaṃ vidhastām |
yogyatayā hi tasya tathābhāvaḥ |
na ca preraṇetyau śabdakartṛkāyā- karaṇībhūtajñānānugrahayogyatā tasya śakyate'vagantum |
puruṣakartṛkāryā pravṛttau tasya yogyatā''vagamaḥ |
, (pra-) śaste pravṛttirdarśanāt |
syānmatam |
apraśasta- (ste) puruṣapravṛttasaṃbhave preraṇaiva nopapadyate |
tadasat na phalasaṃbhavyatā kriyāniṣpattiḥ |
kriyāniṣpatyāthaiva phala- siddhiriti loke pratītam, ata eva tasmin pakṣe niṣphale- 'pi preraṇasiddheḥ pravṛttiḥ syāt |
atha phalamapi iti- kartavyatāpada niveśi prāśastyavat atastadabhāve preraṇā (na) niṣpadyate iti cet |
tarhi phalamevāstu itikartavyatāṃśa- paripūrakam, kiṃ prāśastyena |
satyametat, asti tāvat tadapīti na tyajyate |
evaṃ tarhi aśrutaprāśastye tadapekṣā mā bhūt |
tataśca tadapi deśādikalpanamaghaṭamānaṃ kenalpasya vidheḥ darvihomavat karaṇetikartavyatākalpanā |
kalpanā- mātrameva, darvihomavaditi ca siddho dṛṣṭāntaḥ |
tatra śrauta- dravyadevatātyācāraprāptācamanadātikartavyatāmātreṇa upa- kāraprāpterabhimatatvāt |
nahi ekasyaiva vastunaḥ anugrāha- katā anugrāhyatā ca svāmyanupapadyate |
atha śabdaḥ preraṇā karotyeva pravṛttistu nāvanamātreṇa, kintu tajjñāne sati |
evaṃ tarhi jñānaphalameva pravṛttistattvaṃ, na preraṇāphalam, tasmin sati bhāvāt, asati cābhāvāt |
tathā ca sati śabdabhāvanā vidhiriti na siddham |
kiñca śabdaḥ ambaraguṇaḥ |
iti prāpyakārīndriyavādinā abhyupeyaṃ anyathā namasaḥ śrotrabhūtasya, śabdasya ca prāpyasaṃbhavāt saṃyogasamavāyayoranyatarasya prāptirūpatvāt saṃyogasya anya- tarakarmajasya ubhayakarmajasya saṃyogajasya (ca) dravyatve śabdasya nabhasā sahasaṃbandhatvāt tasya traividhyaniyamāt pāri- śeṣyāt samavāyaḥ |
prāsirityākāśāguṇaḥ śabdaḥ |
na ca tasya vyāpārasaṃbhavaḥ |
dravyāśritasvādhyāyāpārāṇām |
kathaṃ tarhi śabdasyābhidhānalakṣaṇo vyāpāra āśrīyate |
yathā tat, tathā śrūyatām |
yattat ātmani arthaviṣayajñānaṃ śabdaviṣayajñānamanānantaraṃ jāyate, tacchabdakarmarthatayā yadā viṣayate, tadā tat abhidhānamityucyate |
paramthe vyāpāre bhavatyeva kartṛtā parispanda ivātmanaḥ |
iti na kaściddoṣaḥ |
kathaṃ cāsau śabdavyāpāraḥ arthabhāvanā- viṣayaḥ |
ekalpyavyākhyātvāditi cet |
taduktam
‘vidhiśāvanayoścaikapratyayagrāhyatā kutaḥ |
dhātva- rthāt prathamaṃ tāvat saṃvandho'dhyavasīyate ||
’ iti |
tatra |
pratyayasya bhāvanā'bhidhānamasminpakṣe durghaṭaṃ yat |
nanu ca sarvākhyātānāṃ bhāvanāvacanatā karotisāmanādhi- karaṇyāt adhyavasīyate |
tathāhi bhavatyarthasya kartuḥ prayo- jakavyāpāre bhāvanā |
saiva ca kṛtiḥ |
mānyamānasya kriyamāṇatvāt tasya kṛtikarmatvāt |
‘kimakārṣīdapākṣīt, kiṃ karoti pacati, kiṃ kariṣyati pakṣyati’ iti praśnottara- darśanāt |
karotyarthaḥ sarvākhyātarabhidhīyate iti gamyate |
anyathā karotyarthaviṣayapraśne tadattarānupapattiḥ |
tatrāpi satyāmāpi prakṛtau ghañantādiṣu karotyarthānavabodhāt, ākhyātapratyayasaṃnidhāne ca tadavagamāt ākhyātānāmeva so'rtha iti niścīyate |
tadasat |
kiṃ karotītyasya praśnasya yadyamarthaḥ ‘yat karoti tat kim’ iti tatra cet pacatītyuttaraṃ syāt, tadā pākaṃ karotīti syāt tasminnarthe pacatīti vartate |
tathā ca sidhyet ākhyātānāṃ karotya- rthatā |
na caitadevam |
anavagate hi dhātuvācye vyāpāraviśeṣe tadviśeṣaḥ eva evaṃ pṛcchayate |
tatra pacatītyuttaram |
tathā ca na sidhyati dhātvatiriktakarotyarthavacanatā ākhyātānām |
sarvadhātvarthāśca kasyacit abhūtasya bhavane anukūlatāṃ bhajantaḥ karotyarthatāmāpannāḥ karotinā prabhuṃ nirdeṣṭuṃ ca śakyante iti tadarthapraśnaścaite evaite |
kiñca, dhātuvācyavyāpāraviśeṣavacanatvenāpi praśnottarayorupapattau tadatiriktakarotyarthavācakatā ākhyātānāṃ na śakyate vaktum |
api ca saprayatnākriyeṣu devadattādiṣu vyāpārabheda- saṃbhavāt ghaṭetāṃ praśnottare vyatiriktakarotyarthaviṣaye, ‘kiṃ karoti’ iti praśne gacchatīti cottare gamanātirikta- vyāpārābhāvāt anupapattireva syāt |
dhātvarthaviśeṣa- viṣayatve tatrāpyupapattiḥ |
atha saṃyogavibhāgau dhātvarthaḥ, parispandastu vibhaktyartha iti, tatrāpi dhātvarthavyatirikta- vyāpārasaṃbhavāt nānupapattiḥ |
tatra |
parispandasyaiva gamidhātvarthatvāt kevalaṃ saṃyoge vibhāge vā grāmeḥ prayogaḥ, syāṇau ityanena viyukte saṃyukte vā aprayogāt |
nāpi dvayoḥ, utpatya nipalite ityanena syāṇau prayogaprasaṅgāt |
ekākriyākṣaṇajanyo saṃyogavibhāgau gamivācyāviti
yadyucyeta |
tarhi kriyaivāstu vācya kimasāvupādhikoṭī niveśyate |
evaṃ hi upādhisamāśrayaṇagauraveṇa paricchede bhavati |
api ca vṛddhavyavahārāt śabdārthanirṇayaḥ |
na cākhyātānāṃ bhāvanāvacanatvamantareṇa kasyacit vṛddha- vyavahārasyānupapattiḥ |
praśnottare tu saṃbandhaścottarakāla- bhāvī |
ato na tadaṃśena saṃbandhanirṇayaḥ |
katrādi- saṃkhyāmātravācitayā ākhyātaprayogopapattau nādhikaṃ vācyaṃ śakyaṃ kalpayitum |
api ca pākaṃ karoti devadatta ityatra tāvata pacyate pākaśabdo bravīti, tadanuguṇaḥ prayatnaḥ karotirācaṣṭe |
ākhyātaṃ tu kevalakartṛsaṃkhye vaktīti siddhaṃ tanmātrāvacitvam |
ataḥ anyatrāpi tatraiva vartate iti yuktam, evaṃ ca ‘pacati devadattaḥ’ ityasya yat vivaraṇaṃ pākaṃ karotīti, tadapyanupapannam |
pacatītyatra yaḥ puruṣa- prayatno yasaṃbandhena pacyarthaḥ sādhyabhūtaḥ, taṃ karotinā prakṛti- bhūtenopādāya vivaraṇeopapattiḥ |
yatrāpi prayogaḥ ‘gamanaṃ karoti’ iti na prayatnaḥ aparo'sti, tatrāpi gamanasya sādhyatāṃ darśayituṃ gauṇaḥ karotiprayogo draṣṭavyaḥ, pakṣadvaye'pi tulyatvāt |
yastu devadatta odanaṃ pacatītyādau vṛddha- vyavahāra eva prakṛtyarthātirike prayatne prayogāt ākhyā- tānāṃ tadarthatāmāha |
sa itthaṃ śikṣayitavyaḥ |
vāsa kiṃ na vetsi ‘ananyalabhyaḥ śabdārthaḥ’ iti |
iha ca prakṛtyarthā- kṣepeṇāpi prayatnapratītyupapatterna śakyate tadācakṣatā ākhyātānāmāśrayitumiti |
nanu prābhākarā api bhāvanā- vācakatāṃ kathamākhyātapratyayasyecchanti |
ucyate |
na sarvā- khyātāpratyayānāṃ bhāvanāvacanatvamabhyupagamaḥ, kintu kāryā- midhāyino liṅādayaḥ |
kāryasaṃbandhi hi kārye kṛtyāna- midhānenābhihitaṃ syāt |
nahyasti saṃbhavaḥ kṛtiśca nāmi- dhīyate kāryaṃ ca nāmi (ami) dhīyate iti |
atha matam |
yathā daṇḍītyatra pratyayena daṇḍo nāmidhīyate, atha ca tadviśiṣṭapuruṣapratītiḥ |
ityevamihāpi bhavediti |
tatra |
tatrāpi apratīte daṇḍe na tadasti pratyayaḥ |
asti ca tatra prakṛtibhūto daṇḍaśabdaḥ, sa ca tasya pratyayayitā |
na ceha tathā saṃbhavati, prakṛtīnāṃ puruṣavyāpārābhidhāna- niyamāt |
puruṣo hi cetanaḥ kārye liṅādibhiravabudhyate,
na cāsau prakṛtisaṃbandhi svayaṃ kāryaṃ boddhumalamiti tadīya- kulamabhidhānametadviṣayam |
tasya ca kṛtiḥ prayatnarūpā, na ca saṃbandhanubhave tadabhidhāvinaḥ (anubhavaḥ) iti na daṇḍiñyāyetyāyaṃ viṣayaḥ |
syānmatam |
yathā liṅāṃ (liṅāṃ) katrādisaṃkhyāmātravacanatā kriyā'kṣepeṇa ca katrādīnāṃ pratītiḥ, tathaihāpi kriyā prayatnamākṣipatī mā bhūtasya liṅāvacyateti |
tadasat |
yadyapi prakṛtyartha- bhūtayā kriyā prayatnaḥ ākṣipyate |
tathāpi tadākṣaptasiddhikṛtayā kathamapūrva gamyate |
prayatnābhidhāne tadavacchinnatayā abhīdhīyamānaṃ tadāyattasiddhikamagamyate, nāmyathā |
na ca kasyanakvacit svarūpameva pūrvamabhi- hitaṃ kṛtimākṣeptumalama |
avagatasaṃbandhaṃ hi vastu ākṣi- pyate |
na ca śabdamantareṇa apūrvasya prayatnasaṃbandhāvagame kāraṇāntaramasti |
ataḥ kathaṃ tat prayatnamākṣipeta |
tasmādapūrvakāryābhidhāyinā prayatnamābhidhāna avaśyaśakya- ṇīmiti viṣayakaraṇīya nipuṇataramupapāditam, ilamalamatiprasaṅgena |
tatra na kriyāmātraṃ tāvadahaṃ buddhvā pravṛttaḥ, na nāpi phalamātram, na kriyāphalasaṃbandha- mātraṃ vā |
kriyāphalayoḥ sādhyasādhanatā'vagame'pi na pravṛttirupapadyate |
tanmihetorbhojane atīte vartamāne vā apravṛttirbhavatipya tāvatsāmuditāvāyete ivānu- ṣṭhānābhāvāt |
puruṣādyāvagamastu pravṛttihetutayā nāśa- ikitā'pi, svatantrapravṛttī vyutpattidaurbalyasāritatvāt |
kintu kāryatāṃ buddhvā pravṛtto mamedaṃ kāryamiti pratītya ahaṃ sarvatra pravṛttaḥ |
tathāhi ‘āstāṃ tāvat kriyā loke gamanāgamanādikā |
antataḥ stanapānādistattikāryāpi yā kriyā (kārī api) sā yāvannama kāryeyamiti naivāvadhāryate |
tāvat kadā'pi me tatra pravṛtti- rabhavannahi ||
1 pravartanām ||
karturiṣṭābhyupāye hi kartavyamiti lokedhīḥ |
viparītaṃ tvakartavyamiti tadviṣaye tataḥ ||
’ (iti) |
tatra tāvadidameva vaktavyam |
atītasya vartamānasya ca iṣṭāsādhanatā'sti na ca tārkāyatvā ava- sīyate, tenānya kāryatā anyā cetsādhanateti |
tathā ca pravṛttirapi tanmātrāvagamayatā na bhavatīti |
upekṣyaiva tāvat taṃ phalasādhanatākāryatayorbhedaṃ vinirdiśati |
phala- sādhanatā nāma yā, sā naiva ca kartavyā |
‘kāryatā kṛtisādhyatvam, phalasādhanatā punaḥ |
karaṇatvam, phalotpāde bhidyete te parasparam ||
’ yadyapi eka- vastuniveśitā dvayoḥ, tathāpi svarūpabhedo'syeva |
tadeva hi vastu phalaṃ prati upāyabhāvāt phalasādhanamityucyate, kṛtyadhīnātmalābhavatayā ca kāryamiti |
kimiti iṣṭābhyu- pāyecaiva kartavyatā'vagamo'nyatra neti, tatrāha ‘kintu svayaṃ keśarūpaṃ karma kartavyatāṃ brūte |
phalasādhanatā tatra kāryaṃ tena kāryatā ||
tadbhāvabhāvinī nityaṃ tadātmaiva pratīyate |
svabhāvena hi karmāṇi duḥkho- tpādetabhūtāni |
teṣu kāryatā'vagamaḥ phalasādhanatā'vagama- nindhanaḥ |
kāryatā hi kṛtyadhīnasiddhimātrarūpā, kintu kṛti prati pradhānabhūta sat yat tadadhīnasattākaṃ tat kārya- mucyate |
tacca kṛteḥ pradhānam, yat adhikṛtya kṛtiḥ pravartate |
na ca duḥkhaṃ duḥkhahetumaṃtaṃ vā adhikṛtya kṛtyaṃ cirupapannā |
nāpi duḥkhaṃ duḥkhahetuṃ vā |
kintu sukhaṃ sukhahetuṃ vā |

nirvāpannyāya: 2378 nirvāpamantrārtha:
vi— 'nirvāpādiṣu tanmantrāḥ sakṛd medena vā—, 'gnimaḥ |
dravyamaikyato, maivaṃ saṃskārasya pṛthaktvataḥ |
' bhāṭṭa— darśapūrṇamāsayoścaturmuṣṭiparimite vihita- nirvāpasya 'devasya tvā' ityādimantraḥ |
tathā 'ayugmā- yugman muṣṭīn lunāti' iti vihitasya lunanasya 'barhi- devasadanaṃ dāmi' iti |
tathā 'tridhātu pañcadhātu vā vediṃ stuṇāti' iti vihitasya staraṇasya 'ūṇāmadasaṃ tvā stuṇāmi' iti |
'caturjuṣṭhā gṛhṇāti' iti vihitasya ājyagrahaṇasya 'śukaṃ tvā śukāyām' iti mantraḥ samāmnātaḥ |
te kiṃ pratimuṣṭyādi nirvāpādyāvṛttau āva- tainne, na vā iti cintāyām, na tāvada nirvāpādi- bhedaḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ muṣṭyādivṛttitvena pratīteḥ; abhyāsamātraṃ tu nirvāpādeḥ |
ataśca avaghātamantravadanāvṛttiḥ |
iti prāpte, yuktamavaghāte saṃskāradvayasyaikatvāt te eva hi vrīhayaḥ pratiprahāramavahanyante, atastatra sakṛdeva yukto mantraḥ |
prakṛte tu saṃskāradvayamedāt satyapi nirvāpādi- karmaṇyeva pratyabhyāsaṃ mantrabhedaḥ |
na ca nirvāpalavanā- jyagrahaṇādiṣu saṃskārabhede'pi staraṇasya dvitīyā vediṃsaṃskārārthatvāt barhirghātnāṃ ca tatra guṇabhūtatvena kathaṃ saṃskārabhedaḥ ? śatapathabrāhmaṇe 'barhiḥ stuṇāti' iti vidyau barhiṣo'pi staraṇasaṃskāratvāvagateḥ |
'barhiṣaḥ' 'barhiṣi' irvīhyāsādyati' iti vacanena havirāsādana upayuk- tatvācca |
yattu 'vedyāṃ havīṣyāsādayati' iti vacanam, sat vederapi paraṃparayā havirādhāratvāt nānupapannam |
na ca vedirbarhiṣvilapāśāt, 'vedirasi barhiṣe tvā svāhā' iti mantravarṇaina vedeḥ barhiryatvasya bhagavamena vikalpāpādakasākṣādādhāratāvidhāyakatvānupapatteḥ |
ata eva tridhātu pañcadhātu vā ityatra barhiṣa etra saṃskāratā |
vedimiti sammathyai |
astu vā saṃyogapṛthaktvān staraṇasya barhiḥsaṃskārakatvavat vedisaṃskārakatvamapi, vedirbarhiṣoḥ parasparasaṃskāre parasparasambandhasya satvāt, vikalpā- sambhavena 'vedyāṃ havīṣyāsādayati' ityasya paraṃparāsaṃbandha- nuvādakatvam |
vederguṇātvācca 'vedirasi' iti mantravarṇa- syopapattiḥ |
saṃkāratvācca 'yoṣā vai vediḥ tāmanamāṃ karoti' iti staraṇārthatvādasya upapattiḥ |
sarvathā barhiṣo'pi saṃskāryātvādasti staraṇe'pi saṃskārabhedaḥ |
na ca pratyabhyāsaṃ saṃskārabheda'pi sakṛtpaṭhitamantrajanasmṛtera- vicchedāt avaghātamantravat anāpatteḥ |
uttamantreṣu sarvatra yuṣmacchandasaṃbuddhyādiśravaṇena liṅgātsāhasraṇāḍyā apūrvaghātībhūtayuṣmadarthaviṣayanirvāpādi-prakāśanārthatvena mantravidhivagataiḥ, tādṛśasmṛtyā yuṣmadarthaviṣayībhūta- nirvāpādiviṣayasaṃskārājananāt |
atastatra mantrāvṛttireva |
evaṃ ca staraṇe barhiṣo'pi mantrasya viśeṣaṇī- bhūtayuṣmadarthādiprakāśanārthatvena viniyogāt mantrā- vṛttirapīti śakyaṃ vaktum |
maṇḍana— 'nirvāpādī pṛthagdharmāḥ |
15. śaṃkara— 'pratimuṣṭi sa nirvāpe |

aśvino- rbāhubhyāṃ parikriyamāṇamiva yajamānayordevorbāhubhyām |

bhāṣyakāreṇopanyāsaḥ kṛtaḥ, sa kṛtvācintānyāyeneti draṣṭa- vyam|
nahi vidhitvamanuṣyatve manuṣyadharmādipakṣa upa- padyate iti|
vidhiriti kṛtvā prathamaṃ prastutaṃ paścāt lakṣaṇānurūpaṃ vicārya ante pūrvāvasthitameva arthavādatva- mupasaṃhariṣyati|
pareṣvāpi adhikaraṇeṣu etadyathāsaṃbhavaṃ yojayitavyam|
tatra 'vidhivau' syādapūrvatvādādamātrāṃ dhanyathaṃkam' ityanenaiva tāvadvidhiḥ|
ahīnādhikaraṇa- nyāyena ca ṣaṣṭhībhūtvā manuṣyadharmaḥ|
teṣāṃ khatvena tanmatī- yate, na manuṣyāstadaṅgatvena|
guṇavibhaktinirdeśābhāvāt|
arthadeva ca tanmātau satyāṃ naiva manuṣyagrahaṇaṃ kriyate|
kṛtaṃ caitat|
ato'pi manuṣyadharma ityavacchāmaḥ|
apadeśo vā'rthasya vidyamānatvāt|
bhāṣyam-- apadeśa iti sāmānyasya vacanam|
sa eṣa na vidhiḥ, anuvāda eṣaḥ|
kutaḥ ? arthasya vica- mānatvāt|
prāpta evāyeṃ, yaccivītaṃ manuṣyāṇām|
nivītaṃ hi manuṣyāḥ prāyaśaḥ svārthe kurvanti|
tasmādanu- vādaḥ|
vā-- nivītaṃ kecit galaveṇikāgranthaṃ smaranti|
kecidapunaḥ parikarabandham|
tatra galaveṇikābandho yuddhā- danyatra na prāpnoti|
parikarabandhastu sarvakarmasu anyatrākaratvāt prāpta iti tadāśrayeṇānuvādamāha|
sa tu kiṃprayojana ityuttara vakṣyate|
vidhitvapūrvavattvāt syāt|
bhāṣyam-- vidhiraiva bhavet, tathā prayojanavān|
itarathā vādamātramanarthakam|
pūrvavadanuvādo bhavati|
ayaṃ tvapūrvaḥ, yacciyamena nivyātyamiti|
vā-- vidhiraivāyam|
kutaḥ ? pūrvavatvāt hi anuvādo bhavet atyantaprāptāvityarthaḥ|
na cāyaṃ atyantaprāptaḥ|
tena vinā'pi abhyasatvāt śakyatvāt|
kaṇṭhabandhaḥ punaḥ prāyaṇa aprāpta evetyasti niyamavidhiravakāśaḥ|
sa prāyāt karmadharmaḥ syāt|
bhāṣyam-- yadyuktaṃ vidhiriti, etad gṛhyate|
yattu manuṣyadharma iti, tannānumatam|
kṛtudharmo'yaṃ prakaraṇāt|
prakṛtyaiva hi karmaprāyeṣu dharmeṣuprayamāneṣu etadamidhīyate|
tasmāt karmadharmaḥ|
vā-- sati vidhitve karmadharmaprāyapradeśājñānāt kathaṃ- mātrasparśatvāt karmadharmaḥ|
vākyaśeṣatvāt|
bhāṣyam-- nivītaṃ manuṣyāṇāmityasya vākyaśeṣaḥ samākhyā, ādhvaryavamiti|
yadi darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ śeṣaḥ tato'dhvaryuṇā kartavyam|
tatra samākhyā anugrahīṣyate|
vā-- dvedhā saṃbhave tādṛśī pramāṇagatirāśrayaṇīyā, yā pramāṇāntaraṃ na bādhate|
yajurvedajñānācca nivītādeḥ ādhvaryavasamākhyāpavadaṃ vākyam|
tatra yadi karmadharmo- 'yam, tataḥ kartṛviśeṣapekṣāyāṃ satyāṃ samākhyāyā adhvaryuniyamāt samākhyā arthavatī bhaviṣyati|
manuṣya- dharmāṇāṃ tu na samākhyā niyāmakitti vakṣyāmaḥ|
tatrāsau bādhyate|
itarathā anugrahīṣyate|
tasmādapi karmadharmaḥ|
tatrakaraṇe yat, tatsaṃyuttamavipratiṣedhāt|
bhāṣyam-- ucyate|
prakaraṇāt samākhyānāt karma- dharmo vijñāyate|
vākyāt manuṣyadharmaḥ|
tasmādutkarṣa- marhati|
neti brūmaḥ|
prakaraṇe evābhiniviśamānasya manuṣyapradhānatā avakalpiṣyate|
katham ? yat darśapūrṇa- māsayormanuṣyapradhānam, tatra nivekṣyate anvāhārthakarmaṇi|
prakaraṇaṃ caivamanugrahīṣyate, vākyaṃ ca|
vā-- prathamaṃ tāvat manuṣyadharmasyetyatvena karmadharmatvaṃ nirākaroti|
tathāhi suraṃ sūcitaḥ pakṣaḥ|
parigṛhyate|
śrutvā hi prakaraṇasamākhye bādhivā manuṣyadharma eva prāpnoti|
taducyate|
sarvānugrahārthamayaṃ pakṣo'stu|
manuṣyāṇāmiti tanpradhānakarmavyatirekajanitā ṣaṣṭhī na nivītaṃ gṛhṇāti|
tadapi ca prakaraṇāt anvāhārthadānādi pratīyate nānyat|
ata eṣa vākyarthaḥ: 'yadi manuṣyāṇāṃ karma, tatra nivyātyam' iti|
tatpradhāne vā, tulyavatprasaṃkhyānāditarasya tadartha- tvāt|
bhāṣyam-- naitadasti, prakaraṇa niveśaḥ|
iti manuṣyapradhāne karmaṇi nivītaṃ syāditi|
kutaḥ ? tulyavatprasaṃkhyānāt|
tulyāni caitāni prasajyante|
yattāvat 'upāvītaṃ devānāmupavyate' iti, tat prakṛta- yordaśapūrṇamāsayopavītaṃ vidadhāti|
yat, prācīnāvītaṃ pitṛṇāmiti, tat, pitṛdhāne karmaṇi prācīnāvītaṃ vidadhāti|
yadapyetat, nivītaṃ manuṣyāṇāmiti, tadapi ātithye nirapekṣaṃ vidadhāti|
kathaṃ gamyate manuṣyapradhāne vidadhātīti, manuṣyāṇāmiti ṣaṣṭhyantena saṃbandhāt, manuṣyāṇāmeva prāpnoti, na manuṣyapradhāne|
ucyate|
vā-- manuṣyāṇāṃ kalpyamāne phalaṃ kalpanīyam|
manuṣyapradhāne punaḥ ṣaṣṭhī bhaviṣyati, saṃbandhaścaivamavakalpiṣyate, phalaṃ caivaṃ na kalpanīyam|
saha ekavākyatāṃ prāpmaya, punaḥ prakṛtābhyāṃ darśapūrṇamāsābhyāmekavākyatāṃ yāsyati|
nahi dvau saṃbandhau ekasmin vākye vidhīyete|
micyata hi tathā vākyam|
itarasya manuṣyagrahaṇasya nivītasaṃbandhāt tenaiva sahaikavākyatā bhaviṣyati pratyayena śabdena|
tadeka- vākyatāyā arthavattve sati na prakṛtenaikavākyatā aca- kalpyate|
tasmāt prakaraṇaṃ bādhivā ātithye nivekṣyate iti|
vā-- prakaraṇarahitamanuṣyapradhāno vā syāt|
kutaḥ ? 'tulyavaddhi prasaṃkhyānaṃ hṛdayate'smincitre|
tassāntara- pradhāne syāt pitṛdevapradhānavat' ||
yathaiva 'upavītaṃ devānām' 'prācīnāvītaṃ pitṛṇām' iti ca paraspara- nirapekṣadevapitṛpradhānakarmaṇeṣa vidhiḥ|
evaṃ tadbuddhayanu- vṛttermanuṣyāṇāmiti tapradhānakarma pratyekameva|
kathaṃ gamyate iti pṛṣṭhe manuṣyāṇāmiti ṣaṣṭhyantena saṃbandhāt-- ityetāvati uttare datte manuṣyāṇāmeva prāpnoti iti punaśrdayati|
athavā samasta eva caikaḥ praśnaḥ|
satyameva prāpnoti|
phalakalpanāprasaṅgagauravāt parityajyate|
tasmāt tadīyakarmavyatirekādeva ṣaṣṭhī|
tatsaṃnbandhasya nivītasya nāsaṃvadakalpakalpanā bhaviṣyati|
manuṣyagrahaṇaṃ ca saṃpradhānakarmapratipatyarthamiti nānupapatta- saṃbandhāpattiḥ|
na ca tasmin sati prakṛtenaikavākyatā ghaṭate|
arthavādo vā, prakaraṇāt|
bhāṣyam-- naitadasti, vidhiḥ, sa ca manuṣyapradhāne karmaṇīti|
manuṣyāṇāmiti manuṣyasaṃbandho'tra śrūyate, na manuṣyapradhāne karmaṇā saṃbandhaḥ|
manuṣyaprādhānye ca sati phalaṃ kasanīyam|
ātithyakarmaṇā tu anirdiṣṭena apra- kṛtena anumeyena saṃbadhyate|
tatra ko doṣaḥ ? prakaraṇa- duṣkṛtyeta saṃbhavastatra|
kathaṃ saṃbhava iti cet ? arthavāda eṣaḥ|
sa prakṛtaṃ subantaṃ prakaraṇe saṃbhavyati, vidhiḥ san utkṛṣyate|
tasmāt vidhirmanuṣyapradhāne karmaṇīti|
vā-- sarvathā nātra eko'pi pakṣo nidoṣaḥ|
prakaraṇasaṃbandhe vākyasaṃbandhatvāt, annāhārthadisaṃbandhe dvisaṃbandho'pi atyantanirmūla eva|
ṣaṣṭhībhirapi śrutyādi- bhirasaṃsparśatā manuṣyasaṃbandhena tadanumīyate, tacca na yuktam, tasyā api ṣaṣṭhyāḥ nivītapadasaṃbandhavyatirekajanitatva- pratīteḥ|
nahi anupāttasaṃbandhavyatirekaḥ|
(anupāttāḥ: saṃbandhino yeṣāṃ saṃbandhavyākhyānaṃ vyatirekāṇām, taiḥ iti vigrahaḥ ) vibhaktayaḥ utpadyante|
tasmāt manuṣyarthataiva prāpnoti|
tatrāpi ca prakaraṇasalyāvābādhaphalakalpanā- prasaṅgaḥ|
sati ca gatyantare na yuktaṃ tadāśrayaṇam|
asti ca audumbarādhikaraṇasiddhamarthavādatvaṃ gatiḥ|
vidhinā caikavākyatvāt|
bhāṣyam-- itthaṃ na vidhiḥ|
kutaḥ ? vidhinaika- vākyatvāt 'upanayate devalakṣmeva tatkurute' ityeṣa vidhiḥ|
anenāsya saha ekavākyatā bhavati|
yadītaro'pi vidhiḥ syāt vākyaṃ bhidyeta|
nahi vidhīvidheyasya eka- vākyatā bhavati, vacanavyakkibhedāt|
tatraikavākyatā- rūpaṃ bādhyate|
kimekavākyatārūpam ? nivītaṃ manuṣyāṇā- miti prāsānuvādaḥ|
prāsasya kimena punarvacanam ? upa- vītastulyena|
kathamupavītastutiḥ ? nivītayogaṃ deva- karmaṇi darśapūrṇamāsasaṃjñake, manuṣyāṇāṃ hi tat|
tathā prācīnāvītaṃ pitṛṇām, na devakarmaṇi|
upavītaṃ tu tatra yogyam|
tasmādupavītatvāttvamiti|
yathā yāhyo'sya veṣatādṛśo natānām, yāhyo devadattasya tādṛśo brāhmaṇā- nāmiti devadattasyapraśaṃsāyāmitaraveṣakīrtanam|
eva- mihāpi upavītastulyena nivītakīrtanena|
nāsyatra vidhāyakaḥ śabdo nivītaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ kartavyamiti|
ātithyaprayogavacanaṃ tasya kartavyatāvidhāyakamiti cet, naitadevam|
stutyarthena arthavatte sati na śakyaṃ kalpa-
yituma |
parokṣa hi tadānarthakyaparijihīrṣayā kalpyeta |
paricche tu ānarthakye iha punarna kiṃcit kalpanīyam |
tasmādarthavādaḥ |
evaṃ ca vākyena aviruddhaṃ prakaraṇamatha- vadati |
vā-- ' upanayate ' ityanena ca vidhinā eka- vākyatvaṃ nīvītaprācīnāvītayordṛśyate |
taccānuvādadāreṇa śrutau satyāmavakalpate na vicau |
nahi ajñāṅkitvarahitayo- ramayoḥ svatantrayoḥ parasparasaṃbaddhayorvidhīyamānayoreka- vākyatā bhavati, vacanavyakteimedāt |
anyā hi pradhāna- vidhestānmātropasaṃhāriṇī vacanavyaktiḥ, anyā ca śruteḥ |
parāṅgabhāvānugatarūpā |
na cātra vidhāyako dṛśyate |
sa yadi vā adhyātavyaḥ athavā ātithyādigatasthāpi aṅgatvāya parikalpyeta |
na ca tatkalpanaṃ yuktam, avihitasyānajñātvāt, anajñasya ca prayogavacanenāgraha- ṇāt |
vakṣyati hi ' na cāvihitamaṅgaṃ bhavati ' iti |
tatra ajñātvāt vidhiḥ, vidheśca aṅgatvaṃ kalpyeta itītare- tarāśrayaṃ prāpnotīti |
pratyakṣeṇa ca vidhinā yathākatha- ñcidekavākyatāyāṃ saṃbhavatyāṃ na parokṣaikavākyatā yuktā |
tathā sati ca anekāṣṭakalpanā syāt |

' bhāṭṭa-- 'raudraṃ vāstumayaṃ caruṃ nirvapet' iti prakalpya 'etayā niṣādasthapatiṃ yājayet' iti śrutam |
tatra yadyapi niṣādaḥ sthapatiśca iti bahuvrīhau padadvaye'pi anyapadārthalakṣaṇā iti sa nāśrīyate |
tathāpi niṣādānāṃ sthapatiḥ iti ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣe tadabhāvāt, vidyā''kṣepaśakti- kalpanābhimā karmadhārayāṅgīkāreṇa sa evāśrīyate |
na ca tatrāpi pūrvapade niṣādatvanidhani lakṣaṇā, kāraṇābhāvāt |
yadyapi hi klaptāvayavārthayogenaiva upapattau na samāse viśiṣṭārthaśakti- kalpanā prāmāṇikī |
tathāpi karmadhāraye abhedasyaiva ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣādapi svasvāmibhāvādibheda- sambandhasya saṃsarganidhayaiva bhānopapatteḥ lakṣaṇāyāmanupapatti- bhāvaḥ |
na ca naiyāyikavat asmākaṃ nāmārthayorbhedānvaya eva ityatra pramāṇamasti |
rājā puruṣo'sti ityādau sarvatra nāmārthasya vibhaktyarthe, tasya ca ākhyātādyarthe anvayāṅgī- kāraṇa parasparānvayasya samāsātirikte kāpi apramatta- tvāt |
ataḥ samāse eva prasaktasya tasya saṃsargavidhayaiva bhānopapatteḥ na lakṣaṇā |
iti prāpte, samānādhikaraṇapadasthale rājā puruṣo'sti ityādi kriyā''nvayottaraṃ pārśvikānvayasya abhedasambandhenaivānubhavatvāt rājñaḥ puruṣo'sti ityādi vyadhikaraṇapadasthale ca bhedasambandhenaiva anubhavāt lāghavena nāmaprayojyatadarthānvayabodhasya abhedaviṣayatvameva iti niyamakalpanāt svasvāmibhāvādidisambandhasya ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣādau saṃsargavidhayā bhānopapatteḥ avaśyaṃ pūrvapade svārthasambandha- lakṣaṇāmaṅgīkṛtya tasya uttarapadāda abhedenānvayaḥ ityaṅgī- kāryam |
ata eva nāmaprayojyanāmārthaviśeṣakanāmārtha- prakārakābhedasaṃsargabodhatvāvacchinne prati ekādhikaraṇa- vṛttiprātipadikārthatā'vacchedakanāmadvayasamabhivyāhārasya dvaṃdvabhinnanāmadvayasamabhivyāhārasya vā tantratvaṃ ityapi bodhyam |
tena dhavakhadirau, nīlaghaṭau ityādau nāmevodha ityapi bodhyam |
